Job Description: You will serve as a technical subject matter expert on the Annuity Product Management and Development Team and provide system expertise in all aspects of the design, development, maintenance, launch, and sale of Guardian’s individual annuities while working with large and diverse cross-functional teams and outside business partners and vendors. Requirements: Minimum requirements : Expert-level knowledge of annuity product design, administration systems, and product configurations. Education: BA/BS+ or equivalent work experience Strong writing and proofreading skills Experience: 10+ years in financial services, 5+ years working with policy administration systems Advanced skill level in MS Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) Preferred requirements: Proven experience leading the implementation of new product launches and enhancements. Responsibilities: New Product Development and Enhancements Lead the development of detailed specifications for new annuity products and enhancements, driving consensus among cross-functional stakeholders on product features, business rules, and system functionality while managing the development lifecycle and communicating requirements, updates, and changes. Evaluate new product concepts for operational and technical feasibility. Review and approve contract, rider, and prospectus language for consistency with product specifications. Develop and maintain illustration systems. Problem resolution and exception request reviews. Testing Oversight and Product System Specialist (Transcend, ALIP) Review and approve test cases developed by the ESQA and IT teams, ensuring validation of new product features, calculations, business rules, contract values, workflows, and system functionality. Identify testing gaps, request additional test scenarios as needed, communicate defects and approve testing results upon successful validation of product requirements. Act as a liaison between the Product and Technology teams, leveraging deep expertise in annuity products and Transcend administration to translate business requirements into ALIP configuration and design. Client Communications Lead the design, development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of client-facing (regulatory required) communications, including transaction confirmations, quarterly statements, annual statements, and other required disclosures. Partner with IT (ECM), Operations, Compliance, and Legal teams to define business requirements, and ensure accurate representation of product features, values, calculations, and regulatory content across all client and financial rep platforms (Client portal, Client Manager). Annuity Rate Management and Implementation Participate in the weekly deployment of annuity (FIA, RILA, SPIA, DIA, and SPDA) product new business and renewal rates across multiple administration and illustration systems. Update spreadsheets for In-Force rates using rate data provided by Investments/Actuarial. Location While we are open to fully remote candidates in this position, candidates who are located within a commutable distance to a Guardian Life hub-office will be expected to be in-person 3 days per week. Job Description: Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 7+ years of middleware engineering or administration experience supporting mission-critical enterprise applications. Extensive hands-on experience with IBM MQ v9.3/v9.4, including installation, configuration, upgrades, migrations, security hardening, performance tuning, and enterprise production support. Strong experience with IBM MQ Native High Availability, including deployment, administration, failover testing, troubleshooting, monitoring, patching, and production support. Experience designing and supporting high availability and disaster recovery architectures for enterprise messaging platforms. Experience with MQ clustering, distributed queuing, publish/subscribe, and enterprise messaging patterns. Expertise implementing end-to-end security for messaging and integration technologies. Experience integrating IBM MQ with IBM WebSphere Application Server, Apache Tomcat, IBM App Connect Enterprise or IBM Integration Bus, and enterprise Java applications. Strong working knowledge of IBM WebSphere Application Server Network Deployment and Apache Tomcat administration and support. Strong troubleshooting skills across MQ, WebSphere, Tomcat, Java Virtual Machines, application deployments, connectivity, performance, and security. Proficiency with Linux or Unix administration and shell scripting for automation and operational efficiency. Experience with DevOps and automation tools such as Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet, GitHub, or GitLab. Exposure to Amazon Web Services and hybrid-cloud middleware architectures. Preferred Qualifications IBM Certified MQ Administrator certification. AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or equivalent cloud certification. Experience with Splunk, AppDynamics, Amazon CloudWatch, or comparable observability platforms. Experience supporting middleware modernization, cloud migration, or platform transformation initiatives. You Will Enterprise-wide collaboration with application, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, compliance, network, and operations teams. Engineer and operate secure, resilient IBM MQ services, including Native High Availability, clustering, distributed messaging, and disaster recovery capabilities. Administer and improve IBM WebSphere Application Server and Apache Tomcat platforms, including configuration, patching, upgrades, integrations, performance, and production support. Automate provisioning, configuration, validation, monitoring, and operational tasks using scripting, DevOps pipelines, and configuration-management tools. Lead technical troubleshooting for complex middleware incidents and problems, complete root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective and preventive actions. Collaborate across application, infrastructure, cloud, network, cybersecurity, compliance, and operations teams to deliver middleware solutions aligned with enterprise standards, technology strategy, risk requirements, and business priorities. Job Description: Position Summary Are you detail-oriented and passionate about ensuring accuracy and compliance in healthcare provider data? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where organization, communication, and problem-solving are critical to success? Guardian is seeking a Credentialing Support Associate III to support the provider credentialing and recredentialing process by maintaining accurate provider records, coordinating provider outreach, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements. In this role, you will work closely with providers and internal stakeholders to validate information, resolve discrepancies, and support high-quality provider network operations. You Are A highly organized professional with exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy. You thrive in structured processes, enjoy managing multiple priorities, and can effectively communicate with providers to obtain critical information and resolve issues. You understand the importance of compliance and take pride in maintaining accurate records while delivering excellent customer service. You Have Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred Experience supporting provider credentialing, healthcare operations, provider enrollment, or administrative processes Experience maintaining and updating data within databases or business systems Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to follow established processes and regulatory requirements Strong organizational and time management skills Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Outlook Preferred Qualifications Experience with provider credentialing and recredentialing processes Familiarity with NCQA, CMS, state, or other healthcare regulatory requirements Experience conducting primary source verification activities Experience working with credentialing software or provider management systems Knowledge of healthcare provider networks and credentialing standards You Will Maintain accurate provider information by entering, updating, and auditing data within credentialing systems. Coordinate recredentialing activities, including distributing recredentialing communications and monitoring provider responses. Communicate with providers to obtain missing documentation, resolve discrepancies, and ensure complete credentialing files. Conduct primary source verification activities for initial credentialing and recredentialing applications in accordance with regulatory requirements and company standards. Track and follow up on outstanding credentialing requirements to support timely processing and compliance. Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure provider records are accurate, complete, and compliant with organizational policies. Support continuous improvement efforts that enhance credentialing processes and data quality. Reporting Relationships As our Credentialing Support Associate III , you will report to the Credentialing leadership team. Location The primary location for this position is Remote with regional office in Newport Beach, CA . Job Description: Is the opportunity to join a culture where “We Do the Right Thing,” and “We Courageously Shape Our Future Together” important to you? If so, Guardian is seeking a motivated individual to join our team as a Senior Financial Statutory Accountant. This role will support the Statutory and GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) Insurance Accounting and Financial Reporting functions of the Group Profit Center. In this position, you will support a combination of statutory and GAAP subsidiaries while preparing Regulatory and Audited Financial Statements along with related supporting documentation and workpapers for the internal and external auditors and assisting in the completion of audits as required. In addition, you will prepare Board Reports, including Board and Audit Committee material by conducting analytical research and documentation on account variance. You should be an Oracle Super User and the primary go to person in the Dept for questions maintenance related to Oracle and related modules. To be successful in this position, you should possess a detail-oriented mindset to ensure accuracy of data contained in general ledger, account reconciliations and workpapers that support financial statements. Developing strong computer skills especially in the use of MS Excel, Oracle Ledger and SmartView reporting. You will Prepare journal entries and supporting schedules. Reconcile key accounts and analysis of financial data included in the development of Group Profit Center monthly and quarterly financial statements. Prepare Board and Audit Committee material including analytical research and documentation on account variance. Act as SME for questions maintenance related to Oracle and related modules. Add Ad Hoc Reports and Analysis for Management Analysis and Reporting. Identify, communicate, and implement process improvement projects to enhance accounting and reporting controls and provide efficiencies in the financial reporting process. You have 3+ years of related experience (GAAP, Statutory, and Oracle Ledger). CPA preferred but not required. Regulatory, public accounting a plus. Understanding of Statutory and / or GAAP accounting. Bachelor's degree in accounting, economics preferred or equivalent work experience. Demonstrated experience prioritizing work to perform and complete multiple tasks and projects within specific deliverable periods. Detail-oriented mindset to ensure accuracy of data contained in general ledger, account reconciliations and workpapers that support financial statements. Experience with MS Excel, Oracle Ledger and SmartView reporting. Location Hybrid - 3 days in office located in Hudson Yards, NYC, or Holmdel NJ. 2 days WFH. Job Description: Position Summary Are you passionate about helping employees make informed benefits decisions while driving exceptional client outcomes? Do you thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can influence strategy, solve complex challenges, and build strong partnerships? Guardian is seeking an Enrollment Practice Leader to lead the end-to-end enrollment experience for our sales partners, brokers, employers, and members. In this role, you will serve as a trusted enrollment expert responsible for managing complex, high-impact cases, driving enrollment success, and delivering exceptional service experiences. You will partner across Sales, Client Management, and Enrollment teams to execute strategic enrollment solutions while identifying opportunities to improve processes, increase engagement, and support the continued growth of Guardian's enrollment capabilities. You Are A strategic and client-focused enrollment professional who thrives at the intersection of operational execution, relationship management, and enrollment consulting. You are energized by managing complex enrollment initiatives and collaborating with internal partners, brokers, and employers to deliver outstanding enrollment experiences. You have the ability to assess unique client needs, influence decisions, and develop creative solutions that drive participation and successful outcomes. You excel in environments where balancing multiple priorities, managing stakeholder expectations, and solving complex challenges are critical to success. You are a trusted advisor who leverages deep enrollment expertise, industry knowledge, and strong communication skills to guide clients and internal teams through the enrollment process. Success in this role requires a relentless focus on client outcomes, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and helping employees make informed benefits decisions that best meet their needs and those of their families. You Have Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of experience in group benefits enrollment, benefits administration, client management, or a related field. Proven success managing high-volume and high-impact enrollment activities with measurable results. Experience supporting enrollment strategies, including one-on-one enrollments, decision support tools, digital enrollment campaigns, and employee education programs. Strong understanding of group benefits products and enrollment best practices. Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and lead initiatives across multiple teams and business partners. Experience mentoring team members and sharing operational best practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify process improvements and implement effective solutions. Exceptional presentation, communication, and relationship-management skills. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting brokers, employer groups, and distribution partners within the employee benefits industry. Knowledge of enrollment technologies, decision support engines, and enrollment platforms. Experience leveraging enrollment data and performance metrics to improve engagement and outcomes. Experience working in a consultative, client-facing role supporting large or complex accounts. Demonstrated ability to drive operational innovation and process optimization initiatives. You Will Lead and manage the end-to-end group benefits enrollment process, ensuring accurate execution, operational efficiency, and exceptional client outcomes. Serve as the primary Guardian Enrollment contact for distribution partners, brokers, employers, and internal stakeholders throughout the enrollment lifecycle. Gather enrollment requirements, coordinate case-level activities, and execute enrollment deliverables to support successful enrollment events. Provide proactive communication, status updates, and issue resolution to stakeholders while managing ongoing enrollment-related inquiries. Manage complex and high-impact enrollment cases while achieving performance, service, and engagement objectives. Partner closely with Sales, Client Management, and internal operational teams to drive enrollment strategy execution and client success. Provide strategic recommendations and actionable feedback to leadership to improve enrollment processes, client experiences, and team effectiveness. Mentor and support team members through knowledge sharing, coaching, and professional development opportunities. Identify, recommend, and implement innovative and cost-effective solutions that improve operational efficiency and enrollment outcomes. Reporting Relationships As our Enrollment Practice Leader, you will report to our Enrollment Strategy Leader, who reports to our Head of Enrollment. Location The primary locations for this role is either Plano, TX or Newport Beach, CA. Travel Approximately 30%-40% travel is required for this position. Job Description: Do you thrive at the intersection of talent strategy, business partnership, and enterprise program excellence? Are you recognized as a subject-matter expert who brings depth, insight, and strategic perspective to complex talent challenges? If so, Guardian is seeking a Talent Consultant to serve as the strategic talent advisor to designated Lines of Business (LOBs). In this role, you will anticipate business needs, design and implement talent solutions tailored to unique LOB contexts, and shape enterprise talent programs that enable leaders to build high-performing, future-ready teams. You will operate with significant autonomy, influence senior stakeholders, and apply mastery-level expertise to solve complex issues with broad business impact. You are: A seasoned, strategic talent practitioner recognized for your thought leadership and ability to bring clarity to complexity. You are highly consultative, with the ability to understand business dynamics, anticipate needs, and influence senior leaders. You think “enterprise first” while adapting solutions to each business unit’s culture. You thrive in a role where you can innovate, lead complex initiatives, solve ambiguous problems, and serve as a trusted advisor across HR and the business. You have: Required Qualifications 5–8+ years of progressive experience in talent, OE, HR business partnership, consulting, or similar fields; Knowledge in talent management, organizational effectiveness, or related domains Experience partnering with HR and business teams to drive and execute talent initiatives Demonstrated ability to anticipate business challenges and propose process or practice improvements Strong consulting, facilitation, and persuasive communication skills, including conveying complex ideas to diverse audiences Ability to lead through influence and drive adoption of new or evolving talent practices Preferred Qualifications Degree in Industrial Organizational Psychology or Human Resources Proven experience advising senior leaders on complex or sensitive talent matters Project-management skills, with experience leading initiatives with significant scope, ambiguity, and risk Experience leveraging AI to drive HR process improvement You will: Partner with the Line of Business (LOB)/Functional HR Talent Leaders and Partners to help identify, scope, and manage talent-related business needs and use cases around the transformation of work Conduct talent needs Job Description: Is the opportunity to join a culture where “We Do the Right Thing,” and “We Courageously Shape Our Future Together” important to you? If so, Guardian is seeking a motivated individual to join our team as a Lead Specialist, Tax Accounting & Reporting. This role is ideal for a tax professional to join our Corporate Tax organization with approximately 7 – 10 years of relevant experience who is ready to take on greater ownership of complex state and local tax matters while helping shape the future direction of Guardian’s tax function while continuing to develop technical depth and leadership capability. The position will have particular focus on insurance premium tax, sales and use tax, property tax, tax research, tax planning, and process improvement. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with a strategic, forward-looking mindset, proactively identifying emerging tax risks, opportunities, and legislative developments that may impact the organization. In partnering with finance technology team, this individual will play a key role in advancing State and Local tax team’s technology roadmap using Agentic AI, automation, data analytics, and innovative workflow solutions designed to improve efficiency, scalability, and business insight. You will Key Responsibilities Compliance: Support and take ownership of the relationship with our outsourcing partner firm on insurance premium tax compliance and handle related payments & reconciliations, accounting, and internal and external regulatory requirements. Support and take ownership of the relationship with our outsourcing partner firm on sales and use tax and handle related payments & reconciliations, accounting, and internal and external regulatory requirements. Assist (when necessary) with state income and franchise, property tax, commercial rent and other tax compliance and related reporting requirements. Coordinate with external tax advisors as needed on compliance related matters. Financial Close, Tax Planning and Analysis: Prepare account reconciliations and support tax-related financial reporting activities. Provide insights and recommendations to management regarding potential tax planning opportunities, risk mitigation strategies, and operational efficiencies. Research and Audit: Research state and local tax matters, including nexus, sourcing, exemptions, credits, apportionment, and filing obligations. Monitor legislative and regulatory developments affecting premium tax, sales and use tax, and other state and local tax obligations. Respond to state tax notices and support tax audits and information requests. Technology: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tax processes and assist in developing, testing, and governing AI-driven tax solutions integrated with enterprise systems and data sources. Partner with cross-functional teams to obtain and validate tax data, support AI-enabled tax technology, and process improvement initiatives You have Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in accounting required. 7 – 10 years of relevant state and local tax experience in a corporate tax department, public accounting firm, insurance company, or combination thereof. Hands-on experience with insurance premium tax. Experience with sales and use tax compliance and research. Working knowledge of multistate tax compliance and tax research. Strong understanding of accounting principles and account reconciliations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to research technical tax matters and clearly document conclusions. Strong communication skills. Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines with limited supervision. Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the life insurance industry. CPA, CPA candidate, or other relevant professional credentials. Experience with tax compliance, Oracle ERP, data analytics, or tax automation platforms. Experience using or developing Agentic AI models, AI agents, generative AI applications, or workflow automation tools. Familiarity with AI governance, validation, documentation, and human-in-the-loop controls. Experience working with large data sets and translating tax requirements into technology-enabled solutions. Candidate Profile The successful candidate will be a technically strong and motivated tax professional while demonstrating the strategic thinking and leadership potential necessary for future advancement within the organization. This person should be comfortable taking ownership of assigned tax areas, identifying issues independently, and bringing well-researched recommendations to management. Job Description: Job Description: The Senior Analyst Expense Allocations will reside within the Corporate FP&A area of Guardian and oversee developing and maintaining the automated allocation of direct and indirect costs for planning and actuals. Job Title: Client Manager Associate, Premier Market - Syracuse, NY
Job Description: The Client Manager Associate, Premier Market will assume overall responsibility for managing a client book of business in the 2-99 life space. They will be responsible for persistency, growth, and profitability of this book through relationship development with clients, brokers, and key Guardian internal partners. These partners include Underwriting, Sales Support, Service and Claims. This position will also directly work with Sales Representatives to uncover opportunities to add additional lines of coverage to existing business. This position requires the individual to be an ambassador to the business and always use best practices. The Client Manager Associate is directly and/or indirectly accountable for activities associated with renewing plans (plan retention) and adding new lines of coverage (“add issue”) including, but not limited to, generating plan options and quotes for additional lines of coverage. The individual will proactively evaluate their existing book of business for add issue opportunities, as well as handle incoming renewal and negotiation requests. A successful candidate must demonstrate strong customer service acumen, strong consulting/negotiation skills, deep ancillary product knowledge (dental, vision, life, accident, disability, statutory, supplemental health, voluntary benefits, and leave management) with a high degree of operational effectiveness. You will: Build relationships with brokers/producers/plan holders for groups with less than 100 enrolled lives Interpret, deliver, and clearly communicate renewals, alternative plan options, and add issue quotes to the broker/producer/client Review experience and utilization reports with Sales Reps for groups with under 100 lives; Package and deliver appropriate reports based on group size and availability Proactively identify add issue opportunities for groups under 100 lives by utilizing Salesforce Reports and other strategies developed in collaboration with Sales Reps and generating quotes. Follow up with broker/producer regarding status of renewals and add issue quotes while also engaging the Sales Rep, as needed, to help close the renewal or sale. Provide renewal rate relief for groups under 100 lives through negotiations with underwriting, as well as determining and generating plan alternative options Serve as subject matter expert on various Guardian systems, capabilities, products, and workflow procedures You have: Excellent written and oral communication skills Excellent customer service soft skills Very strong mathematical aptitude and analytical skills Strong consultative, negotiation, persuasion, and influencing skills with a sales orientation Ability to build and maintain collaborative working relationships at all levels A client-focused approach Personal accountability Strong planning and organizational skills with ability to multi-task Ability to easily adapt to change Ability to work independently and in a group setting Motivation to meet goals:  Meet persistency goals, renewal target goals, cross-sell goals (add issue), etc. Computer proficiency in Outlook, Skype, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Salesforce, GCRS, Siebel, CPS, Phoenix, Business Objects, etc. Ability to represent Guardian in a professional manner The successful hire must be based in Syracuse, NY or Albany, NY. The work arrangement will be remote. Knowledge: Solid knowledge of group insurance products, contracts, and services. Group insurance products include dental (PPO, DHMO, fully insured and ASO), vision, life, accident, short- and long-term disability (fully insured and ASO), statutory disability, supplemental health, voluntary benefits, and leave management (federal, state, and local). Solid knowledge of financing methodologies and strategies (fully insured and alternate funding) Solid knowledge of group insurance underwriting principles, methodologies, and practices Education: BA or BS Degree is preferred. Will consider work experience equivalent. Experience: 3 to 5 years of insurance industry experience, preferably in a sales environment Demonstrated success in servicing brokers/producers/customers Other: Eligible for variable compensation for persistency and renewal target bonus and cross-sell/add-issue bonus, according to the current year Group Sales Incentive Compensation Plan for Client Manager Associates Must achieve required industry licensing within 90 days of date of hire and maintain license through completing Continuing Education requirements Location and Work Arrangement: The successful candidate must be based in the assigned territory: Syracuse, NY or Albany, NY. The work arrangement will be remote (work from home). Minimal travel associated with the position (less than 10%). Job Description: Job Profile Summary Job Summary: The Team Coach - Coaching & Transformation for India supports the scaling and sustained adoption of BTOM-aligned ways of working and promotes consistent, high-quality coaching practices across assigned product teams and value streams Job Description: Coach product teams on agile practices to drive delivery discipline and predictability. Provide 1:1 role-based coaching for Product Owners and other team members to strengthen agile maturity. Apply coaching methodologies to support cross-functional product teams in improving collaboration, enhancing delivery cadence, and achieving outcomes aligned with product goals. Facilitate team-level ceremonies (e.g., planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) to ensure effective collaboration, alignment, and dependency management. Coordinate with other teams to manage cross-team dependencies and maintain alignment. Escalate blockers to senior coaches or leadership as needed to ensure timely resolution. Support teams in improving performance through ongoing inspection of team practices and adoption of new approaches. Work with teams to define and develop objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned with enterprise and value stream priorities; assist in tracking progress through performance dashboards. Guide teams to leverage flow and outcome metrics effectively to inform improvement; support development of targeted coaching plans to enhance team performance and maturity. Contribute as a member of the Center of Excellence by adopting standards, sharing learnings, and supporting continuous evolution of the operating model. Partner with Product Owners to build and maintain a strong backlog aligned with product strategy and priorities. Collaborate with stakeholders to support team needs and maintain alignment with product goals. Reinforce team understanding of how their work contributes to product and value stream OKRs. Must have: 7–9 years of experience in roles such as Scrum Master or Agile Coach, working with agile teams in a scaled environment. Good knowledge of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, etc.) with experience in agile delivery practices and ability to reinforce strong team habits. Ability to coach teams using supportive and adaptive techniques to drive continuous improvement. Experience with agile tooling (e.g., Jira, SPM) and applying best practices for team-level adoption. Exposure to OKR development and outcome-based performance tracking. Solid understanding of software development lifecycle and technology delivery. Familiarity with product platform constructs preferred. Working knowledge of engineering practices such as test automation, CI/CD, and DevOps. Good facilitation, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to maintain alignment and transparency across teams and stakeholders. Good to have skills : Developing enterprise mindset beyond team-level execution Ownership and accountability for team-level outcomes Inclination towards action, experimentation, and continuous improvement Location: This position can be based in any of the following locations: Chennai, Gurgaon Current Guardian Colleagues: Please apply through the internal Jobs Hub in Workday

Job Description: Are you a lifelong learner, and passionate about solving complex IAM problems? Then join our IAM Engineering team. This role will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting identity and access management (IAM) solutions to ensure the security and efficiency of the organization's IT infrastructure. This role involves working closely with various groups to understand their IAM needs and providing expert guidance on standard methodologies and solutions. Key Responsibilities Include : Extensive hands-on experience in SailPoint IIQ LCM and connector/automation implementation. Serve as an SME (Subject Matter Expert) for Identity and Access Management domain. Design, develop, and implement technical solutions as part of our Identity and Access Management strategy to meet risk and compliance regulations. Develop and maintain technical documentation, technical diagrams, and visual workflows. Lead IAM projects by executing and delivering automation, integrations, connectors, and self-service capabilities to end users, and building dashboards/reporting. The ability to communicate with all levels of the organization in a comprehensive manner (i.e., translating and presenting technical information to business). Manage priorities, deliverables, by partnering with cross-functional teams and third-party vendors. Act with accountability and responsibility. Dedication to continuous improvement, security process engineering, and operational excellence. Support internal and external audits and risk assessments. Requirements: Hands-on Expertise (5+ years) in SailPoint IdentityIQ platform features and functionality. Hands-on experience in scripting/developing one of the following: Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, BeanShell, Python, Visual Basic Hands-on experience with integrating SailPoint with other third-party systems (SaaS/PaaS) and developing custom forms, workflows, quicklinks, reporting and enhancing entitlement reviews overall process. Hands-on experience with different types of connectors - Webservice APIs, SCIM, JDBC, Delimited Feed File, SFTP connectors. Hands-on experience with SailPoint infrastructure, upgrades, and performance tuning. Knowledge of all different types of databases such as MSSQL, MYSQL, Aurora RDS/EC2 Postgres, Oracle, and DB2. Knowledge of platforms such as Windows, Linux, Unix, and RACF Mainframe. Solid understanding of security risk, implementation of mitigating controls and compliance standards including SOX, SOC, MAR, and NYDFS. Knowledge of entitlement reviews, native changes, offboarding, onboarding, transfer, advance SOD configuration Knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID, OKTA, LDAP directories. Experience developing and continuously improving processes, procedures, and controls. Proactive mindset and ability to work independently on numerous projects/activities at the same time with minimal oversight. Excellent customer focus is on supporting a positive customer service climate. Experience working closely with IT engineers to solve problems, think critically, design and implement solutions, Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to synthesize information. Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and AWS. Experience with AI Control Plane, and Non-Human Identities (NHI) A “lifelong learner” of new concepts and technical capabilities. Job Title: Client Manager Associate, Premier Market - Great Lakes
Job Description: The Client Manager Associate, Premier Market will assume overall responsibility for managing a client book of business in the 2-99 life space. They will be responsible for persistency, growth, and profitability of this book through relationship development with clients, brokers, and key Guardian internal partners. These partners include Underwriting, Sales Support, Service and Claims. This position will also directly work with Sales Representatives to uncover opportunities to add additional lines of coverage to existing business. The Client Manager Associate is directly and/or indirectly accountable for activities associated with renewing plans (plan retention) and adding new lines of coverage (“add issue”) including, but not limited to, generating plan options and quotes for additional lines of coverage. The individual will proactively evaluate their existing book of business for add issue opportunities, as well as handle incoming renewal and negotiation requests. A successful candidate must exhibit competence in customer service, adept consulting/negotiation skills, extensive ancillary product knowledge (dental, vision, life, accident, disability, statutory, supplemental health, voluntary benefits, and leave management) with a high level of operational efficiency. You will: Build relationships with brokers/producers/plan holders for groups with less than 100 enrolled lives. Interpret, deliver, and clearly communicate renewals, alternative plan options, and add issue quotes to the broker/producer/client. Review experience and utilization reports with Sales Representatives for groups with under 100 lives; Package and deliver appropriate reports based on group size and availability. Proactively identify and address opportunities for groups under 100 lives by applying Salesforce Reports and other strategies developed in collaboration with Sales Representatives to generate quotes. Follow up with broker/producer regarding status of renewals and add issue quotes while also engaging the Sales Representative, as needed, to help close the renewal or sale. Provide renewal rate relief for groups under 100 lives through negotiations with underwriting, as well as determining and generating plan alternative options. Serve as subject matter expert on various Guardian systems, capabilities, products, and workflow procedures. You have: College degree or equivalent work experience preferred 3 +y ears of insurance industry experience, preferably in a sales environment with demonstrated success in servicing brokers/producers/customers Demonstrated written and oral communication skills Excellent customer service soft skills Excellent proficiency in mathematical concepts and strong analytical abilities Strong consultative, negotiation, persuasion, and influencing skills with a sales orientation Ability to build and maintain collaborative working relationships at all levels Strong planning and organizational skills with ability to multi-task Ability to work independently and in a group setting Motivation to meet goals: Meet persistency goals, renewal target goals, cross-sell goals (add issue), etc. Computer proficiency in Outlook, Skype, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Salesforce, GCRS, Siebel, CPS, Phoenix, Business Objects, etc. Knowledge: Solid knowledge of group insurance products, contracts, and services. Group insurance products include dental (PPO, DHMO, fully insured and ASO), vision, life, accident, short- and long-term disability (fully insured and ASO), statutory disability, supplemental health, voluntary benefits, and leave management (federal, state, and local). Solid knowledge of financing methodologies and strategies (fully insured and alternate funding). Solid knowledge of group insurance underwriting principles, methodologies, and practices. Job Description: Are you passionate about helping people during important moments in their lives? Guardian is seeking Customer Service Representatives to join our award-winning Contact Center team. In this role, you will serve as a trusted resource for policyholders, helping customers navigate life insurance coverage, policy administration, payments, and account updates while delivering a professional, empathetic, and accurate service experience. This is an opportunity to build a meaningful career with a company committed to your professional growth, development, and success. What It is Like to Work for Guardian While customers are at the center of a service-oriented business, at Guardian we believe our employees should receive the same attention, care, and support. In addition to a competitive benefits package, we are intentional about creating an environment where employees feel valued, supported, and equipped to succeed. At Guardian, you will find development opportunities that allow you to grow in your role and align your work with your future career goals. Growth may come through continued industry education, shadowing, project work, coaching, or opportunities to become a subject matter expert. We want you to know that hard work is acknowledged, appreciated, and supported. We are looking for customer-focused candidates who enjoy helping others, solving problems, and working in a structured, high-volume inbound contact center environment. Our Contact Center is known for delivering outstanding customer experiences, and we want to work with individuals who are motivated to provide clear guidance, accurate information, and care in every interaction. You will: Respond to customer inquiries regarding life insurance coverage, premiums, loans, policy administration, and account updates while delivering a consistent and caring customer experience. Research and resolve customer questions, including premium or loan payment matters and eligible policy changes such as address or beneficiary updates. Explain policy information, coverage details, and available administrative options clearly so customers understand next steps. Recognize when customers should consult with their financial professional or when complex matters require escalation to the appropriate internal team. Properly verify callers by obtaining required data points or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) to ensure information is provided to the appropriate party. Navigate multiple systems, customer records, and knowledge resources while maintaining the flow of the customer conversation. De-escalate customer concerns, set clear expectations, and follow through on next steps to support timely resolution. Document customer interactions accurately and in a timely manner in accordance with procedures. Meet service and quality expectations in a high-volume environment, including schedule adherence, quality assurance, productivity, and customer experience measures. You are: Driven and inspired to show care and empathy in ways that positively impact the customer experience. Comfortable learning complex insurance products, internal procedures, and service standards. Detail-oriented, with a commitment to providing accurate information and following procedures consistently. Able to use resources, ask thoughtful questions, and solve problems quickly and independently. Calm under pressure and able to maintain professionalism during challenging customer conversations. You have: Previous experience in retail, hospitality, banking, insurance, contact center, or another customer-facing service environment. A high school diploma or equivalent; additional education or equivalent work experience is welcome. Superior oral and written communication skills Strong organizational skills and an ability to multitask Comfort using computers, customer databases, knowledge resources, and multiple systems while documenting information accurately. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-based environment. A positive attitude and dedication to providing superior customer service. #LI-Hybrid Salary Range: $42,830.00 - $64,250.00 The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. Job Description: The Manager of our Trade Operations is responsible for leading the firm's order acceptance, execution and reporting functions across both the Broker-Dealer (BD) and Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) businesses. This role oversees critical trading functions including order acceptance, order allocations, best execution, order rules management, regulatory reporting, margin oversight, and trade corrections. The position also leads team governance initiatives, partnering closely with Compliance, Technology, custodial partners, and business stakeholders to drive operational excellence, risk management, and an exceptional advisor and client experience. You will Primary responsibility is the management of a team accepting securities orders, and questions regarding securities orders, from financial advisors and clients. Actively monitoring the team for adherence to our service level agreements and procedures. Responsible for managing the firm’s implementation of the order entry and acceptance rules engine. Manage the firm’s Best Execution responsibilities. This role would be responsible for the oversight of the firms best execution responsibilities and be the Relationship Owner with our vendor partner. Primarily responsible for the compliance of the firm's trade-related regulatory reporting for all security types, e.g. equity, options, fixed income, alternatives, FX. Manage the margin process for both the RIA and BD business. Manage the firm’s responsibilities regarding order blocking, execution and allocation with the firm’s managed account platforms (AdvisorEngine, Orion, and Envestnet). Manage the process of goal setting (improvement) and monitor the adherence to our goals throughout the year. Administers, develops, communicates, and presents key metrics/reporting to management at all levels. Updates/creates miscellaneous documents for various platforms i.e., meetings, conferences, SLT, etc. Oversee and inspire a high performing team through daily coaching, training, and call/contact listening, providing tailored development feedback to each team member, and driving employee engagement. Proactively monitor schedule adherence and behaviors to ensure team members are in the right place, at the right time, to effectively serve our customers. Manage Team Procedures Reviews and Attestations – responsible for ensuring the team has finalized written operational procedures and oversees the regular review and attestation process for all operational teams. Job Description: We are currently seeking a strategic and collaborative Associate, Enterprise Strategy & Planning . In the highly impactful role, you will help develop the long-range plans for Guardian and partner with key stakeholders to identify, develop, evaluate, prioritize and deliver strategic initiatives across the organization.  You will support internal consulting engagements to solve critical strategic questions for the Guardian Leadership Team, working with senior sponsors, business units, and corporate functions, while partnering closely with the rest of the Enterprise Strategy team. A successful candidate will work across the Enterprise Strategy & Transformation team to provide strategic frameworks and deliver on critical strategy projects.  You will structure problem-solving, conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses of operational and financial data, and organize industry/ competitor research to continuously evaluate Guardian’s positioning.  You will also synthesize your findings for senior-level audiences through both written and verbal communications. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to Guardian's business while creating pathways for long-term career development and internal mobility. The role reports to Guardian’s Head of Enterprise Strategy & Planning.  You will partner closely with Guardian’s Corporate Development, AI Strategic Transformation, and Finance teams, as well as counterparts in business units and corporate functions. Your work will span across: Enterprise-wide strategy development – Work to define the strategic direction, with both near-term and long-term priorities for Guardian.  This will be supported by research, analytics, and logical problem solving and strategic frameworks. Internal strategy consulting – working with a senior sponsor, execute deep-dive strategy projects on high priority topics for the business units and corporate functions Strategic planning – support with the enterprise-wide processes that drive strategy, including objectives and target setting, portfolio planning, and quarterly progress updates. Identify, frame, and implement specific cross-cutting strategic initiatives that are critical to the success of Guardian’s overall strategy. Job Description: Position Overview: The Head of Risk Technology is responsible for defining and executing the technology strategy that enables Guardian's enterprise risk management capabilities. This role serves as the primary technology partner to Risk leadership, shaping the future vision, roadmap, and operational management of the ServiceNow Risk platform, including Integrated Risk Management (IRM), Business Continuity Management (BCM), Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), and related governance and compliance capabilities. The leader will build strong partnerships across Risk, Digital & Technology and business functions to ensure risk management solutions align with business objectives. The role is accountable for platform strategy, roadmap planning, technology operations, enhancements, delivery governance, vendor management, and continuous improvement of risk technology capabilities. Key Responsibilities: Define and maintain the multi-year technology vision and roadmap for enterprise risk management platforms. Shape the future of technology-enabled risk management through automation, AI, analytics, and platform innovation. Partner with Risk leadership to align technology investments with business priorities and regulatory requirements. Drive technology strategy discussions and influence enterprise architecture decisions impacting Risk platforms. Build strong partnerships with executive stakeholders to understand priorities, challenges, and future needs. Facilitate alignment across business, technology, platform, security, and vendor teams. Lead governance forums, steering committees, and strategic planning discussions. Own the technology strategy and lifecycle management for ServiceNow Risk modules: Integrated Risk Management (IRM) Business Continuity Management (BCM) Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Model Risk Management (MRM), where applicable Collaborate with the ServiceNow platform team to establish and maintain platform governance, standards, and release management practices. Accountable for day-to-day technology operations supporting ServiceNow Risk solutions. Lead incident, problem, and change management processes associated with risk technology platforms. Manage delivery teams, support resources, and strategic partners to achieve service objectives. Oversee upgrade planning, technical debt reduction, and platform modernization. Lead a blended team of internal resources, contractors, and strategic partners. You Have: 10+ years of technology leadership experience. Deep experience with ServiceNow IRM/GRC platforms and risk management processes. Proven ability to define technology strategy and translate vision into execution. Strong executive presence with exceptional relationship management skills. Experience leading complex technology operations and transformation programs. Strong understanding of enterprise risk, compliance, governance, and regulatory environments. Demonstrated success managing cross-functional teams and strategic vendors. Job Description: Is the opportunity to join a culture where “We Do the Right Thing,” and “We Courageously Shape Our Future Together” important to you? If so, Guardian is seeking a motivated individual to join our team as a Global Capital Risk Analyst. Reporting to the Head of Operations, Service, Claims & Transformation Finance, this role plays a central position within Group Benefits Finance, supporting financial analytics, performance insights, and strategic decision support across all operational areas. This role will help shape Guardian’s enterprise capital planning across its U.S. and Bermuda-domiciled entities. This role offers a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of capital strategy, regulatory frameworks, investment decisions, and business planning, with exposure to senior cross-functional partners and analysis that directly informs capital forecasting and enterprise decision-making. You will partner closely with Investment Management, Corporate Actuarial, Asset/Liability Management, Enterprise Risk Management, and Enterprise/Line of Business Financial Planning and Analysis, giving the analyst a broad view into how critical financial, investment, and strategic business considerations tie together. This position reports to the Head of Global Capital Risk Management who, in turn, reports to the Head of Market Risk. You will Manage a continuous forecast of regulatory capital (RBC and BSCR), while driving standardization and synergies across RBC and BSCR models to modernize and strengthen enterprise-wide capital planning. Analyze and monitor actual financial results to identify implications to Guardian’s capital position and build a deeper understanding of key risks and emerging opportunities across the enterprise. Develop a thorough understanding of Guardian’s asset allocation strategy and how investment decisions influence capital outcomes. Proactively drives opportunities to support capital optimization across the balance sheet, gaining exposure to high-impact initiatives that shape Guardian’s financial strength. Support data and technology initiatives around building capital-related databases and interactive capital dashboards that enhance transparency, analysis, and decision support for senior leadership. You are A self-motivated professional who is energized by ownership, continuous learning, and the opportunity to shape important work independently. Adept at translating complex topics into clear, concise messages for senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners. Able to use data to tell a compelling story, frame thoughtful recommendations, and drive practical solutions. Eager to build trusted relationships across levels and functions, with an interest in learning how different areas of the business connect to capital planning and strategy. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, balancing multiple deliverables. Organized with a strong attention to detail. You have 5+ years of experience in the life insurance industry; familiarity with Bermuda’s capital framework highly desirable. Degree in finance, accounting, economics, or other quantitative discipline preferred. FSA, CPA, or CFA charterholder/candidate preferred. Skilled in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; Claude and Python a plus. Proven communication and relationship building skills. Location: Hybrid role - 3 days in a Guardian office located in Hudson Yards, NYC. 2 days WFH. Job Description: We are seeking a specialized, collaborative, and delivery-focused professional to advance the Service and Operational Strategy for Financial Protection and Retirement Solutions (FPRS). Reporting to the Service and Operations Strategy Leader, you will independently advance complex workstreams that turn strategy into results; translating roadmaps and operating-model designs into rigorous analysis, business cases, and implementation-ready plans across new business and inforce service, operations, and contact center functions. You will apply strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills across current-state assessment, opportunity identification, business-case development, and operating-model design, applying autonomy to develop customized solutions and escalating the most complex tradeoffs. You will help convert strategic priorities into measurable operational outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Conduct current-state analysis of operations, customer journeys, channel performance, service demand, and cost drivers, and translate findings into prioritized transformation opportunities. Evaluate strategic levers across automation, digital containment, workflow optimization, and AI-enabled solutions, including requirements definition, vendor and tool assessment, and impact sizing. Support the development of business cases, roadmaps, and implementation plans in partnership with technology, customer experience, finance, and operational leaders. Execute and lead complex or specialized analysis of outsourcing, managed service, nearshore/offshore, and hybrid delivery models, including cost-benefit modeling, risk assessment, and transition planning. Help define and document operating model requirements, including roles, governance, process ownership, controls, workforce impacts, and change management routines. Establish and track KPIs and success measures for transformation initiatives, and build the reporting that shows progress against targets. Prepare for and support cross-functional workshops and leadership discussions, driving alignment and capturing decisions, actions, and follow-through. Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, competitive practices, and customer behavior shifts to keep the operations strategy future-ready. Manage execution across multiple initiatives, coordinating timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder inputs to keep strategic priorities on track. You are: Delivery-oriented: Experience independently executing strategic, transformation, or process-improvement initiatives from analysis through implementation. A fast learner: Able to quickly absorb new businesses, processes, and tools, and apply that understanding to solve problems. Driven: Brings energy and a hunger to make an impact, taking ownership and pushing initiatives forward. Strategic: Able to see the bigger picture, frame opportunities, and connect analysis to actionable recommendations and roadmaps. Analytical: Ability to analyze operational, financial, workforce, and customer data to identify opportunities, quantify impact, and influence recommendations. Collaborative: Proven ability to contribute to cross-functional initiatives, manage ambiguity, and support alignment across teams with competing priorities. A strong communicator: Ability to simplify complex topics, develop clear narratives, and present recommendations to leaders. Autonomous and accountable: Able to work independently with guidance in the most complex situations, applying sound judgment to develop customized solutions. You have: Bachelor’s degree required. 5+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate or business strategy, operations strategy, transformation, or business process improvement. Strong analytical and project management skills, including proficiency with data, business case development, and executive-ready materials. Experience with operating-model transformation, including automation and AI platforms used to modernize processes. Familiarity with contact center, workforce planning, operations, and service functions is a plus. You will: Help shape and execute the modernization of our service and operating model Develop a deep understanding of FPRS businesses, workflows, and processes Partner closely with operations leadership, contact center leaders, customer experience, workforce management, technology, procurement, and change management teams Be supported by the Service and Operations Strategy Leader while being empowered to independently drive workstreams, challenge the status quo, and grow into broader strategic responsibility Salary Range: $103,450.00 - $169,960.00 The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. Job Title: Assistant General Counsel, Client Solutions & Wealth Management
Job Description: Guided by our company Purpose of “Inspiring well-being for our colleagues, consumers, and communities,” we are committed to building a best-in-class Law Department. We drive a high-performance culture across our Legal, Compliance, and Government Affairs functions, aligned to “what” we deliver (i.e., our goals and objectives) and “how” we demonstrate our values and behaviors while focusing on the customer. We do this through leveraging a series of core capabilities, which includes accountability, interpersonal effectiveness, ability to demonstrate business savvy, being a subject matter expert, all while supporting the Law Department’s Mission to be a trusted advocate and advisor to drive strategic solutions that advance Guardian’s purpose, priorities, and values. Do you want to be part of a collaborative Legal Team? This role will support the day-to-day operations of Guardian’s Client Solutions & Wealth Management (“CSWM”) Practice in the Law Department. You will play a critical role in providing legal advice to business partners regarding Guardian’s individual markets business with a particular emphasis on the distribution of individual insurance products, and support for the company’s broker/dealer and registered investment adviser as well as supporting its advanced markets team. Job Title: Lead Platform Engineer – Cloud & Developer Platforms (Kubernetes Required)
Job Description: Lead Platform Engineer – Cloud & Developer Platforms Role Overview As a Lead Platform Engineer – Cloud & Developer Platforms , you will design, build, and operate Guardian's enterprise cloud application platforms and automation ecosystems. You will own critical components of the Amazon EKS platform lifecycle while also acting as a broad platform generalist, supporting automation, system design, and operational tooling that enable application teams to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads safely and consistently. This role balances deep Kubernetes platform ownership with versatile engineering skills across scripting, Linux systems, automation, Helm charts, CI/CD, and serverless workflows. The focus is on operational reliability, security-by-default patterns, and disciplined platform lifecycle management that accelerates developer productivity while reducing operational risk. You Are A Lead-level senior individual contributor reporting into platform leadership with strong hands-on expertise in Amazon EKS, combined with broad engineering depth across cloud platforms, automation, and systems troubleshooting. A technical authority and escalation point who enforces platform standards across production, non-production, and disaster recovery environments, using automation, guardrails, and repeatable practices. Comfortable operating with autonomy and sound judgment under ambiguity, applying operational data, platform maturity signals, and architectural principles to guide decisions. A pragmatic "get-things-done" engineer who can move fluently between platform design, scripting, debugging, and incident response. You Will Complement deep EKS ownership with generalist platform responsibilities, including: Designing and maintaining automation and scripting solutions Debugging Linux-level, container, and networking issues Improving system reliability through tooling and standards Cluster and environment architecture Kubernetes and EKS version upgrades Node, AMI, and add-on lifecycle management Platform security controls and operational governance Design and operate CI/CD and automation pipelines for platform and infrastructure components using: Jenkins and Groovy GitHub and GitHub Actions Terraform Python and Shell scripting Lead the design and evolution of cloud platforms that support diverse workload patterns, including: Web services and APIs Long-running and background services Containerized workloads on Amazon EKS Serverless and event-driven workflows using AWS Lambda and Step Functions Embed validation controls, security gates, and safe promotion and rollback mechanisms directly into pipelines and workflows. Ensure platforms and workloads meet Guardian's observability standards by integrating with the enterprise observability and monitoring tooling, with telemetry and alerting aligned to workload criticality. Integrate approved security scanning tooling into delivery and platform pipelines for dependency and container image scanning. Act as a senior escalation point for platform-related production incidents, leading or contributing to root cause analysis and driving durable remediation. Partner closely with Application Engineering, Security Engineering, Observability, and Architecture teams to influence workload design, enforce secure-by-default patterns, and align with Guardian standards and future-state architecture. Mentor engineers and contribute to raising overall platform engineering, automation, and operational maturity. You Have (Must Have) 7+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, or closely related roles. Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Amazon EKS, including real-world production operations and upgrades. Broad engineering depth beyond Kubernetes, including: Linux systems troubleshooting Container runtimes and Docker Automation and scripting for operational workflows Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and serverless execution models. Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or equivalent tools. Experience building and operating CI/CD automation using Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions. Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and Shell. Solid understanding of how application architecture decisions impact reliability, security, and operations. Experience designing and operating platforms consumed by multiple application teams at enterprise scale. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex, cross-layer issues spanning: Kubernetes platforms Linux and containers CI/CD and automation tooling Security and observability systems Location Three days a week at a Guardian location in Holmdel, NJ; or Bethlehem, PA. Job Description: Senior Automation Lead Test Engineer – UI & API Automation Job Profile Summary We are seeking a Senior Automation Lead Test Engineer – UI & API Automation with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions for enterprise applications. This role combines deep UI automation expertise with strong API testing and API automation capability The Senior Automation Lead Test Engineer will define and execute automation test strategies, build robust frameworks using Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript or Java, integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines, and collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, Lead Engineers, and QA partners to ensure requirement clarity, end-to-end test coverage, and defect prevention. Key Skills UI automation: Strong hands-on experience with Playwright as the preferred tool, with Selenium as a plus. API testing and automation: Strong experience with REST API testing using RestAssured, Postman, Newman, and Java or JavaScript/TypeScript based API automation. Framework design: Ability to design and enhance scalable automation frameworks using hybrid, keyword-driven, data-driven, BDD, and Page Object Model approaches. Programming: Strong coding proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Java with an automation-first engineering mindset. End-to-end testing: Ability to connect UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and functional test coverage across application flows. CI/CD and DevOps: Experience with Jenkins, Git, pipelines, test reporting, debugging tools, and continuous testing practices. Quality engineering fundamentals: Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, quality gates, defect prevention, and test coverage strategy. Cloud and infrastructure: Working knowledge of AWS or cloud-based device/browser farms such as BrowserStack. AI-assisted testing: Ability to use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Playwright AI-assisted locators, and test generators to accelerate script creation, refactoring, and documentation. Additional exposure: Performance testing tools such as JMeter or Gatling, accessibility testing, security testing, and regulated domain experience are preferred. Required Qualifications 6–8 years of experience in QA, software testing, or quality engineering. At least 4 years of hands-on automation testing experience across UI and API automation. Strong experience building automation frameworks and reusable test components. Hands-on experience with Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript; Java experience is strongly preferred for API automation. Experience with REST API testing and automation using RestAssured, Postman, Newman, or equivalent tools. Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams with distributed stakeholders. Strong analytical, debugging, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to mentor junior QA engineers, conduct automation code reviews, and influence quality practices across teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or other regulated domains. Exposure to performance, security, and accessibility testing for web applications. Working knowledge of AWS or other cloud platforms. Experience improving automation maturity, test stability, release confidence, and sprint quality metrics. Roles and Responsibilities Requirement clarification: Partner with Product Owners, developers, Lead Engineers, and technical teams to ensure test scenarios align with business intent and acceptance criteria. Backlog and test planning: Participate in grooming and sprint planning, refine acceptance criteria, define test coverage, and ensure automation opportunities are embedded into sprint scope. Automation framework ownership: Design, develop, maintain, and enhance scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Playwright, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, RestAssured, Postman, and Newman. UI and API test development: Build reusable test components, utilities, test data strategies, service validations, API contracts, and end-to-end automated test flows. Execution and reporting: Execute automated regression, smoke, functional, integration, and API test suites; analyze results, identify failure trends, and communicate actionable insights. CI/CD integration: Integrate automated tests into Jenkins/Git-based pipelines to support continuous testing, quality gates, and faster release feedback. Defect identification and RCA: Identify defects early, perform root cause analysis, collaborate with developers on permanent fixes, and improve defect prevention practices. Testability and engineering partnership: Collaborate with UI and backend engineers to improve testability through stable selectors, test IDs, API readiness, mocks, data setup, and service-level validation. UAT and business support: Support business users during UAT cycles with test clarification, quick triage, and validation support. Documentation and best practices: Maintain test documentation, automation guidelines, reusable templates, framework standards, and coding best practices. AI-assisted quality engineering: Use AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Playwright AI-assisted locators, and test generators to accelerate automation creation, refactoring, documentation, and productivity. Continuous improvement: Drive improvements in automation coverage, test reliability, execution efficiency, sprint quality metrics, and release confidence. Team leadership: Mentor junior QA engineers, support automation code reviews, promote knowledge sharing, and influence quality-first engineering behaviors. Work shift: Work in overlapping time zones with US teams as required to support collaboration and delivery continuity. Job Title: Wealth Management Senior Customer Service Specialist
Job Description: The Senior Customer Specialist serves as a trusted escalation resource and relationship builder for the Park Avenue Wealth Management Customer Service Desk. This individual is responsible for supporting complex advisor, client, and internal partner inquiries, acting as the first point of contact for escalations, and ensuring that each interaction is handled with accuracy, empathy, professionalism, and ownership. This role is designed for an experienced service professional who can navigate complex situations, build trust with advisors and internal stakeholders, identify recurring service trends, and partner with team leaders to improve training, procedures, and operational effectiveness. The Senior Customer Specialist helps create meaningful service experiences that reinforce confidence in the Wealth Management Customer Service Desk and strengthen relationships across Park Avenue Wealth Management. Key Responsibilities Escalation and Complex Issue Management Serve as the first point of contact for escalated advisor, client, and internal partner inquiries requiring advanced research, judgment, and follow-through. Own complex service issues from intake through resolution, ensuring timely communication, accurate documentation, and clear expectations with all parties involved. Partner with internal subject matter experts, operations teams, technology teams, and business partners to resolve issues efficiently and accurately. Apply sound judgment, policy knowledge, and service expertise to determine appropriate next steps and ensure consistent handling of escalated matters. Ensure Customer Service Representatives are following established escalation procedures, including proper issue identification, documentation, routing, and communication expectations. Identify issues that require leadership awareness, risk review, operational change, or broader communication to the service desk. Advisor, Client, and Partner Relationship Management Build meaningful relationships with advisors, their support staff, clients, and internal partners through consistent, responsive, and trusted service interactions. Represent the Customer Service Desk as a reliable and knowledgeable partner who demonstrates empathy, accountability, and professionalism. Help restore confidence in situations where service expectations have not been met by listening carefully, communicating clearly, and driving resolution. Serve as a relationship bridge between frontline service, relationship management, operations, technology, and advisor-facing teams. Promote a service culture focused on creating moments that matter through trust, expertise, and ownership. Trend Identification and Continuous Improvement Track and document recurring escalation themes, complex service issues, process gaps, advisor pain points, and knowledge gaps observed across the desk. Analyze escalation trends to help team leaders determine whether additional training, procedural clarification, technology updates, or operational changes are needed. Provide actionable feedback to leadership on emerging risks, service inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and the advisor experience. Partner with team leaders to reinforce complete and accurate information delivery across the Customer Service Desk. Team Support and Knowledge Sharing Support Customer Service Desk representatives by serving as a knowledgeable resource for complex questions, unusual scenarios, and escalation readiness. Share expertise in a way that strengthens team confidence, reinforces service standards, and promotes consistent execution. Help team leaders identify coaching opportunities, training needs, and best practices based on escalation patterns and call observations. Participate in team huddles, training discussions, and process review sessions to promote continuous learning. Model strong service behaviors, including active listening, clear communication, accountability, and a calm approach to difficult situations. Required Qualifications Demonstrated experience in a customer service, advisor support, financial services, operations, or wealth management service environment. Strong understanding of service desk operations, escalation handling, client service standards, and relationship-based support. Ability to research, interpret, and communicate complex information accurately and clearly. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to tailor messages to advisors, clients, peers, and internal partners. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, follow through on commitments, and maintain professionalism under pressure. Experience identifying process gaps, documenting trends, and recommending practical improvements. Comfort working with service systems, knowledge resources, CRM tools, and Microsoft Office applications. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience supporting financial advisors, wealth management platforms, brokerage operations, investment operations, or client service teams. Experience mentoring peers, supporting training initiatives, or assisting with quality and knowledge management efforts. Familiarity with Park Avenue Wealth Management processes, advisor support models, client service expectations, and operational workflows. Ability to translate complex operational or technical information into clear guidance for service representatives and advisors. Role Competencies Customer-Centric Judgment: Balances empathy, ownership, policy knowledge, and business judgment when resolving complex issues. Relationship Building: Creates trust with advisors, clients, internal partners, and service desk colleagues through reliability and follow-through. Escalation Ownership: Takes accountability for difficult issues and drives resolution through collaboration and clear communication. Analytical Thinking: Identifies trends, root causes, and service gaps that may require training, process clarification, or operational improvement. Communication Excellence: Communicates complete, accurate, and timely information in a professional and easy-to-understand manner. Team Leadership Without Authority: Influences peers through knowledge sharing, modeling service standards, and supporting team learning. Adaptability: Responds effectively to changing priorities, new processes, technology updates, and evolving advisor needs. Measures of Success Escalated issues are resolved accurately, timely, and with clear communication to advisors, clients, and internal partners. Advisor and internal partner trust is strengthened through consistent ownership, professionalism, and follow-through. Recurring escalation trends are documented and shared with leadership in a way that supports training, process improvement, or operational change. Service representatives receive timely guidance and support that improves consistency, accuracy, and confidence across the desk. Knowledge gaps, process gaps, and service pain points are identified early and translated into actionable recommendations. The Customer Service Desk continues to provide complete, accurate, and relationship-driven support aligned to the needs of advisors and their clients.
