Job Title: Head of Group Benefits Business Risk & Resiliency
Job Description: As the Head of Group Benefits Business Risk & Resiliency, you will execute the Risk & Resiliency frameworks for Group Benefits (GB), Guardian’s B2B line of business. You will manage the operational risk profile for GB, aggregating risk across domains (Technology, Cyber, Data, Model, Compliance, Third Party, etc) and ensuring alignment to Guardian’s risk appetite and tolerance. You will enable informed business decision‑making by providing oversight, independent challenge, and proactive risk insights, supported by risk domain experts within Enterprise Risk Management (ERM). You will Act as a trusted advisor to GB Leadership to drive the Risk & Resiliency program according to Guardian standards, in part by facilitating Risk Working Groups on a regular cadence for transparency and accountability. Escalate topics to the appropriate risk committees as warranted. Assess key risks at the Line of Business and process level and ensure visibility into key risk action items through coordination and engagement with business process owners and risk and control partners. Execute the Business Resiliency framework through development of business continuity plans and resiliency solutions for critical dependencies, regular testing, and oversight of plans, and managing business coordination of Disaster Recovery and Crisis Management efforts. Own and drive maintenance of the Risk Register (ServiceNow) for GB, including establishing reporting standards, promoting self‑identification of risks, and ensuring data quality and completeness. Oversee consolidation and synthesis of risk data across all domains to maintain an aggregated residual risk profile, assess alignment to risk appetite, identify material risk themes and trends, and inform LOB leadership and risk governance discussions. Coordinate and integrate risk activities, including issues, events, Key Risk Indicators(KRIs), and stress scenario analysis, ensuring appropriate linkage, escalation, and consistency across domains. Drive a risk‑aware culture, enabling first‑line ownership of risk and partnering with Business Risk Coordinators to promote consistent standards, effective issue identification, and timely escalation. You are A confident, visible leader and trusted advisor comfortable operating in a highly transparent environment, engaging senior leaders, risk committees, and cross‑functional stakeholders to support informed business decision‑making. A change leader with strong business acumen who provides clear risk insights, credible challenges, and pragmatic trade‑off perspectives to advance business priorities. An exceptional communicator and collaborative relationship builder with a proven ability to partner across lines of business, risk domains, and enterprise functions to drive outcomes through others. Job Title: Wealth Operations and Complex Case Support Specialist
Job Description: Are you energized by solving complex problems and partnering closely with advisors to bring sophisticated wealth strategies to life? As a Wealth Operations & Complex Case Support Specialist, you will provide high‑touch, end‑to‑end implementation support for large, complex, and multi‑product wealth cases once a client has decided to move forward. This role partners directly with advisors, particularly those without dedicated operations infrastructure to guide them through systems, documentation, and execution complexity. You are A strong execution partner who thrives in complexity and ambiguity and enjoys working directly with advisors and internal teams to drive outcomes. You are known for your ability to translate complicated operational requirements into clear, actionable next steps, and you take pride in seeing sophisticated cases through from post ‑ sale to completion. You are comfortable operating without a script, proactively identifying risks, clarifying ownership, and ensuring momentum in high ‑ stakes, detail ‑ oriented work. You will Lead end-to-end implementation oversight for large, complex, and multi-product wealth cases, ensuring post-sale activity advances through funding, execution, and completion with clear ownership and accountability. Serve as a senior escalation and advisory partner to investment advisers, third-party sponsors, and internal teams, translating complex requirements into practical execution plans and timely next steps. Provide high-touch guidance across required processes, systems, documentation, account structures, sequencing, and dependencies while reinforcing advisor ownership and avoiding duplication of existing responsibilities. Coordinate cross-functional execution with Business Development, Service, Trading Operations, Compliance, Licensing, clearing partners, custodians, and platform sponsors to resolve barriers and maintain momentum on priority cases. Evaluate operational risk, handoffs, escalation points, and process gaps; proactively recommend solutions that reduce advisor friction, improve client delivery, and strengthen controls. Develop and support training, reference materials, and process guidance for relevant products, platforms, and workflows to build field and internal partner capability. Contribute to pilot programs and evolving service models by identifying implementation themes, documenting lessons learned, and supporting scalable improvements for complex-case support. You have Demonstrated experience in wealth management operations, including exposure to advisory, annuity, and/or alternative investment products Strong working knowledge of complex operational workflows, systems, and documentation requirements Experience partnering directly with advisors or frontline teams in execution‑heavy environments Proven ability to manage multiple dependencies, handoffs, and escalation points Clear, calm communication skills with the ability to explain complex processes step by step Sound judgment, accountability, and comfort operating in evolving or pilot environments Salary Range: $82,770.00 - $135,975.00 The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. Job Description: Head of Enrollment As Head of Enrollment, you will lead the enterprise enrollment function for Guardian Group Benefits and be accountable for driving enrollment success, participation, and employee engagement across our customer base. You will set the strategic direction for Guardian’s enrollment capabilities and ensure our enrollment model delivers measurable impact for customers, brokers, sales teams, and client management partners. You will report directly to the Head of Group Benefits Distribution and are accountable for building and leading a high-performing enrollment organization. This includes oversight of enrollment practice leads, directly contracted enrollers, and Guardian’s partnership network with enrollment firms. You will work closely with sales and client management leadership to maximize participation, strengthen the customer experience, and ensure enrollment is a clear differentiator in the market. You Are A strategic and commercially minded leader who understands the critical role enrollment plays in driving customer value, employee engagement, participation outcomes, and business growth. An influential relationship builder who establishes credibility across sales, client management, brokers, customers, enrollment partners, and senior leaders. A customer-focused problem solver who balances strategic thinking with operational excellence to deliver exceptional enrollment experiences. Job Title: Client Manager Associate - Chicago, IL & Indianapolis, IN
Job Description: Guardian's Group Benefits Client Management team is hiring a Client Manager Associate! The Client Manager Associate, Premier Market will assume overall responsibility for managing a client book of business in the 2-99 life space. They will be responsible for persistency, growth, and profitability of this book through relationship development with clients, brokers, and key Guardian internal partners. These partners include Underwriting, Sales Support, Service and Claims. This position will also directly work with Sales Representatives to uncover opportunities to add additional lines of coverage to existing business. This position requires the individual to be an ambassador to the business and always use best practices. The Client Manager Associate is directly and/or indirectly accountable for activities associated with renewing plans (plan retention) and adding new lines of coverage (“add issue”) including, but not limited to, generating plan options and quotes for additional lines of coverage. The individual will proactively evaluate their existing book of business for add issue opportunities, as well as handle incoming renewal and negotiation requests. A successful candidate must demonstrate strong customer service acumen, strong consulting/negotiation skills, deep ancillary product knowledge (dental, vision, life, accident, disability, statutory, supplemental health, voluntary benefits, and leave management) with a high degree of operational effectiveness. You will: Build relationships with brokers/producers/plan holders for groups with less than 100 enrolled lives. Interpret, deliver, and clearly communicate renewals, alternative plan options, and add issue quotes to the broker/producer/client. Review experience and utilization reports with Sales Reps for groups with under 100 lives; Package and deliver appropriate reports based on group size and availability. Proactively identify add issue opportunities for groups under 100 lives by utilizing Salesforce Reports and other strategies developed in collaboration with Sales Reps and generating quotes. Follow up with broker/producer regarding status of renewals and add issue quotes while also engaging the Sales Rep, as needed, to help close the renewal or sale. Provide renewal rate relief for groups under 100 lives through negotiations with underwriting, as well as determining and generating plan alternative options. Serve as subject matter expert on various Guardian systems, capabilities, products, and workflow procedures. You have: Excellent written and oral communication skills Excellent customer service soft skills Very strong mathematical aptitude and analytical skills Strong consultative, negotiation, persuasion, and influencing skills with a sales orientation Ability to build and maintain collaborative working relationships at all levels A client-focused approach Personal accountability Strong planning and organizational skills with ability to multi-task Ability to easily adapt to change Ability to work independently and in a group setting Motivation to meet goals:  Meet persistency goals, renewal target goals, cross-sell goals (add issue), etc. Computer proficiency in Outlook, Skype, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Salesforce, GCRS, Siebel, CPS, Phoenix, Business Objects, etc. Ability to represent Guardian in a professional manner Knowledge: Solid knowledge of group insurance products, contracts, and services. Group insurance products include dental (PPO, DHMO, fully insured and ASO), vision, life, accident, short- and long-term disability (fully insured and ASO), statutory disability, supplemental health, voluntary benefits, and leave management (federal, state, and local). Solid knowledge of financing methodologies and strategies (fully insured and alternate funding) Solid knowledge of group insurance underwriting principles, methodologies, and practices Education: BA or BS Degree is preferred. Will consider work experience equivalent. Experience: 3 to 5 years of insurance industry experience, preferably in a sales environment Demonstrated success in servicing brokers/producers/customers Other: Variable compensation for persistency and renewal target bonus and cross-sell/add-issue bonus, according to the current year Group Sales Incentive Compensation Plan for Client Manager Associates. Must achieve required industry licensing within 90 days of date of hire and maintain license through completing Continuing Education requirements. Location: The preferred locations for this position are Chicago, IL or Indianapolis, IN. The work arrangement will be hybrid (partial in office; partial work from home). Job Description: As a Premier Sales Representative for The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America in Oregon, you will drive new business development, cultivate client relationships, and strategically manage the sales pipeline to achieve ambitious sales targets within the Oregon market. This includes Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Absence, and Supplemental Health products. Support the general wellbeing of the broker and client relationship for the development and growth of Guardian sales and client retention. Experience and knowledge of relevant industry products and processes including, but not limited to Worksite, LTD, Dental products, complex absence products, online enrollment, experience rating, dental network analysis processes. Job Description: Description The Principal Engineer – Annuity Platforms & Transformation serves as technology people leader responsible for driving solution design, architecture and technology direction across Guardian's Annuity technology ecosystem. This role operates at the intersection of business strategy, architecture, engineering execution, and technology transformation, ensuring annuity platforms evolve to support Guardian's long-term growth objectives and 2030 technology strategy. The Principal Engineer will provide technical leadership and solutions across the full annuity value chain, including: New Business & Illustrations Policy Administration Servicing & Operations Distribution & Partner Integrations Data & Analytics Digital Experiences Integration Platforms & Enterprise Services This role partners closely with business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, engineering teams, and external technology partners to define future-state solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with Guardian's strategic objectives. The successful candidate combines deep engineering expertise, annuity domain knowledge, and a passion for innovation to deliver sustainable technology solutions that improve customer experience, advisor experience, operational efficiency, and business agility. You are A hands-on technical leader and platform thinker with deep experience in insurance/annuity ecosystems. You are equally comfortable discussing enterprise architecture with senior technology leaders, reviewing detailed technical designs with engineers, and collaborating with business leaders to solve complex business challenges, while constantly focusing on innovation. You have a proven track record of modernizing enterprise platforms, influencing technical direction across multiple teams, and translating business capabilities into scalable technology solutions. You thrive in fast-paced transformation environments, balancing long-term architecture objectives with practical delivery and execution realities. You will Domain & Technical Leadership Purpose: Enable the end-to-end technology vision, architecture, and solution strategy across the annuity ecosystem Partner with enterprise and domain architects to establish future-state platform architecture and multi-year technology roadmaps. Define technology guardrails to ensure consistency across annuity platforms. Lead architecture and solution reviews, design governance, and critical technical decision-making Serve as a trusted technical advisor across annuity technology initiatives. Translate strategic business objectives into scalable, secure, and maintainable technology solutions. Ensure alignment between enterprise architecture direction and delivery execution. Identify opportunities to simplify applications, reduce redundancy, and improve platform interoperability. Distribution & Third-Party Ecosystem Enablement: Purpose: Build scalable technology capabilities that enable Guardian’s growth through third party distribution channels and strategic partnerships. Partner with third-party distributors, broker-dealers, RIAs, custodians, aggregators, and strategic technology providers to define and deliver scalable technology solutions. Collaborate with business and product teams to improve advisor onboarding, product access, servicing, and transaction capabilities. Define reusable API, event, and integration frameworks that enable efficient connectivity across Guardian and external partner ecosystems. Ensure third-party solutions are fully integrated with core annuity platforms and enterprise capabilities. Support Guardian's 2030 distribution strategy by creating scalable technology foundations that accelerate ecosystem growth and partner enablement. Drive platform strategies that enhance advisor, partner, and customer experiences while improving speed-to-market and operational effectiveness Annuity Modernization & Platform Transformation Purpose: Modernize the annuity technology while improving scalability, resiliency and operational efficiency. Provide technology solutions across policy administration, operations, servicing, distribution, and data platforms. Enable modernization of legacy annuity platforms and supporting ecosystems. Manage the Annuity workflow & Integrations Develop strategies for application rationalization, platform simplification, and technical debt reduction. Advance adoption of cloud-native, API-first, event-driven, and domain-driven architecture patterns. Drive engineering excellence through CI/CD, automation, observability, reliability engineering, and quality engineering practices. Evaluate emerging technologies and industry platforms to support future business growth. Influence technology investment decisions through data-driven recommendations aligned to business outcomes. Innovation & Engineering Excellence Purpose: Drive innovation and engineering maturity within the Annuity domain to enable Guardian’s long term Annuity growth strategy. Champion innovative technology solutions that support Guardian's long-term annuity growth strategy Explore and enable opportunities involving Artificial Intelligence, intelligent automation, advanced analytics, and emerging technology trends. Promote experimentation, continuous improvement, and modern engineering practices across annuity teams. Identify opportunities to accelerate delivery, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer and advisor experiences through technology innovation. Foster engineering excellence by promoting reusable architecture patterns, modern development practices, and continuous learning. Engineering Leadership & Influence Provide technical mentorship and guidance to engineers, architects, and delivery teams. Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Influence technology investment decisions through data-driven recommendations and business outcome alignment QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or related field. 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including experience as a senior/lead engineer in enterprise platforms. Proven experience working on policy administration systems, preferably within Annuities and exposure to ALIP platforms. Strong experience in API-driven and event-driven architecture patterns, including orchestration and integration across distributed systems. Hands-on experience in building web-based applications with programming languages (Java, SpringBoot, .NET, Node JS), microservices architecture, event-driven architecture, cloud-native development on AWS. Experience developing and maintaining front-end applications using React, TypeScript and/or Next.js. Experience designing and implementing integrations utilizing SNS/SQS, Apache Kafka, S3 Experience designing intuitive, developer-friendly APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger specifications and industry standards such as ACORD, IRI Digital First, ACORD NGDS, and DTCC Insurance & Retirement Services frameworks. Strong experience with version control and CI/CD automation tools, including Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions Experience implementing API security and access control using OAuth 2.0, JWT, and token‑based authentication Working experience with Splunk (logging), AppDynamics, JSON/XML, Caching, Performance Analysis & Profiling, Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive practical, implementable solutions. Demonstrated ability to lead engineering teams, influence technical decisions, and collaborate effectively with architects, product, and business stakeholders. Experience working in large-scale transformation programs or platform migrations is highly preferred Proven track record of developing and supporting large scale business critical systems. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; solid understanding of coding aesthetics, able to review code, and provide suggestions Must be comfortable in a fast pace, changing environment where the majority of your teammates are remote and/or in different time zones. Jump in and hit the ground running with a positive attitude.  Not easily deterred by ambiguity. Job Title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
Job Description: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability Reports To Head of Technology Operations Department Enterprise Technology Position Summary The Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise observability strategy, operating model, and platform roadmap that enable proactive, predictive, and resilient technology operations. This leader owns the enterprise capabilities for monitoring, telemetry, event intelligence, operational analytics, and observability engineering, ensuring technology services are observable, measurable, actionable, and continuously improving. The role serves as the operational intelligence leader across Enterprise Technology, providing the platforms, standards, insights, and governance required to improve service reliability, accelerate issue detection and resolution, and support modern operational practices. This leader partners closely with infrastructure, cloud, middleware, application, security, resiliency, and service management teams to build a unified enterprise-wide observability capability. Key Responsibilities Enterprise Observability Strategy Define and execute the enterprise observability vision, strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap. Establish standards and governance for monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, alerting, and service observability. Lead the evolution of observability capabilities from reactive monitoring toward proactive, predictive, and automated operations. Drive enterprise adoption of modern observability practices, frameworks, and engineering standards. Observability Platform Ownership Own the strategy, architecture, lifecycle, and operation of enterprise monitoring and observability platforms. Lead platform modernization, tool rationalization, capability expansion, and service offering improvements. Manage vendor relationships, contracts, platform investments, and cost optimization efforts. Ensure scalability, availability, resilience, and ongoing enhancement of observability tooling and services. Monitoring and Telemetry Services Establish enterprise monitoring and instrumentation standards across infrastructure, cloud, middleware, applications, databases, and digital services. Improve monitoring coverage, telemetry quality, alert effectiveness, signal quality, and operational visibility. Drive adoption of distributed tracing, service dependency mapping, and end-to-end transaction monitoring. Ensure service health and operational data are consistently available across the technology landscape. Operational Intelligence and AIOps Lead implementation of operational analytics, event intelligence, anomaly detection, predictive insights, and AIOps capabilities. Develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide actionable operational intelligence to technology leadership. Enable intelligent event correlation, noise reduction, automated diagnostics, and automated operational workflows. Partner with engineering and operations teams to use observability data for continuous improvement and outage prevention. Reliability and Incident Enablement Partner with technology teams to improve detection, response, recovery, and root cause analysis capabilities. Establish observability practices that improve service reliability, operational resilience, and customer experience. Drive post-incident learning and identification of automation opportunities. Provide enterprise visibility into technology health, performance trends, capacity risks, and reliability risks. Leadership and Talent Development Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of observability engineers, platform engineers, and operational intelligence specialists. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, operational excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional partnership. Lead organizational adoption of observability best practices through enablement, coaching, and stakeholder engagement. Establish strong partnerships across technology, cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, operations, resiliency, and service management functions. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in infrastructure operations, platform engineering, observability, reliability engineering, or related technology disciplines. 5+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale engineering or operational teams. Deep expertise in observability platforms, monitoring technologies, telemetry pipelines, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and operational analytics. Demonstrated experience implementing enterprise monitoring strategies and improving operational reliability at scale. Strong understanding of cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructure, automation, DevOps practices, and modern operational architectures. Experience leading organizational transformation and driving adoption of new operational capabilities. Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills. Success Measures Increased enterprise monitoring and observability coverage. Reduced mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR). Improved signal quality and reduced alert fatigue. Increased adoption of observability standards and platform capabilities. Improved service reliability, operational resilience, and operational efficiency. Expansion of predictive analytics, automation, and AIOps capabilities across Enterprise Technology. Job Description: Company Overview: Every day, Guardian gives 27 million people the security they deserve through our insurance and wealth management products and services. Since our founding in 1860, our long-term view has helped our customers prepare for whatever life brings whether starting a family, planning for the future, or taking care of employees. Today we’re a Fortune 250 company and a leading provider of life, disability and other benefits for individuals, at the workplace and through government sponsored programs. Do you have the desire to be part of a collaborative & innovative technology group? Is a culture where “People Count” and “We do the Right Thing” and “We Hold Ourselves to Very High Standards” important to you? Digital & Technology at Guardian: Digital & Technology (D&T) drives Guardian’s innovation agenda and operational excellence. As a key enabler of Guardian’s Journey to ’30, D&T leverages technology, data, AI, and modern engineering practices to create exceptional customer experiences, support our partners, and empower our colleagues. Through a strong focus on customer-centricity, diversified solutions, expanded reach, and operational excellence, D&T is helping shape the future of how Guardian delivers value across the enterprise. Building the Future of Architecture at Guardian: We're building a high-impact architecture community that will help shape the future of technology at Guardian. Across business-aligned and enterprise architecture roles, our architects influence strategic technology decisions, drive modernization, and help connect business strategy to execution. We are hiring architects across a range of domains—including Group Benefits Technology, FPRS & CSWM Technology, Corporate Functions Technology, Cyber Security, Data, AI, API, Digital, and Enterprise Architecture—and are looking for leaders who can bring strong architectural thinking, technical depth, and the ability to influence across a complex enterprise. Beyond the opportunity to solve challenging business and technology problems, architects joining Guardian today will help define how architecture partners across the organization in the years ahead. You'll collaborate with leaders across engineering, platforms, security, data, AI, and the business to establish standards, guide strategic investments, and create solutions that enable Guardian's long-term success.[JS1] Position Overview: The Principal Enterprise Architect is a senior architecture leader responsible for shaping, guiding, and advancing enterprise architecture across the organization. Reporting to the Head of Enterprise Architecture and Engineering Enablement, this role translates enterprise strategy into practical architecture direction, standards, target-state designs, and transition roadmaps across business capabilities, applications, platforms, data, integration, cloud, security, and emerging technology domains. While architecture is foundational, the Principal Enterprise Architect will be responsible for designing enterprise solutions in close collaboration with the business and technology stakeholders.   Where applicable the role will be accountable to build solutions that scale for the enterprise. This position plays a critical role in connecting enterprise strategy to federated execution. The Principal Enterprise Architect partners with architecture, engineering, platform, security, data, and business technology leaders to ensure material technology decisions align with enterprise standards, target-state architecture, modernization priorities, and governance requirements. This role operates within a federated Enterprise Architecture (EA) model, partnering closely with business technology and platform teams to shape solutions in real time while improving accountability, speed, and delivery alignment. The architect remains connected to the central EA core through enterprise standards, governance, communities of practice, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure consistent, risk-aware technology decisions across domains. The role requires strong strategic thinking, architecture breadth, executive communication, and the ability to influence across a large, complex, and federated enterprise environment. The Principal Enterprise Architect provides architecture leadership and recommendations on material technology decisions and has delegated authority within the enterprise architecture operating model as assigned by the Head of Enterprise Architecture and Engineering Enablement. The role is expected to escalate decisions with enterprise-wide impact, non-standard exceptions, or significant risk implications. Key Responsibilities: Enterprise Architecture Leadership ·      Support the Head of Enterprise Architecture in developing and evolving enterprise architecture strategy, principles, standards, and target-state roadmaps. ·      Define and maintain architecture perspectives across business, application, data, integration, cloud, platform, security, and AI-related capabilities as applicable. ·      Own enterprise standards, target state, governance, exceptions, material technology decision frameworks ·      Translate enterprise strategy and target-state direction into practical guidance for domain architecture and engineering teams. ·      Promote alignment across business units, shared services, and technology domains. ·      Where applicable, the role will be accountable to build solutions that scale and algin to business and technology requirements. Strategic Architecture and Transformation ·      Provide architecture leadership for major strategic initiatives, modernization programs, and enterprise-impacting technology decisions. ·      Assess architecture options and recommend solutions that balance business value, cost, risk, resilience, time to market, and long-term maintainability. ·      Support enterprise transformation through simplification, rationalization, modernization, and platform reuse. ·      Identify opportunities to reduce duplication, retire legacy complexity, and improve interoperability across the enterprise. Governance and Decision Support ·      Participate in and support enterprise architecture governance, standards councils, review boards, and strategic decision forums. ·      Evaluate material technology decisions using approved enterprise frameworks, including buy, build, reuse, partner, and retire options. ·      Review architecture proposals for compliance with enterprise standards, target-state architecture, and risk requirements. ·      Support management of architecture exceptions, including rationale, risk analysis, remediation paths, and time-bound approvals. ·      Available for production incidents with major impact to business operations Cross-Functional Partnership ·      Partner with federated domain architects, platform leaders, engineering teams, data and AI teams, security, infrastructure, and business technology leaders to drive alignment. ·      Facilitate resolution of cross-domain design issues, architecture conflicts, and overlapping capability decisions. ·      Act as a trusted advisor to leaders across technology and business-aligned delivery organizations. ·      Ensure architecture direction is understood and applied consistently across federated teams. ·      Works with Business Unit heads and principal solution architects to translate enterprise direction into federated execution. Risk, Security, and Resilience ·      Incorporate cybersecurity, privacy, resilience, recoverability, and regulatory considerations into architecture guidance and recommendations. ·      Partner with risk, security, and compliance stakeholders to ensure technology decisions align with enterprise control requirements. ·      Assess the operational and architectural implications of technology choices in regulated and high-availability environments. Talent and Capability Development ·      Mentor and coach architects and senior technology professionals. ·      Contribute to architecture capability development, communities of practice, and architecture operating model maturity. ·      Support common role expectations, competency models, and quality standards across the architecture function. ·      Promote enterprise-first thinking, sound decision-making, and strong architecture discipline. You Have: Required Qualifications ·      Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field. ·      12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, domain architecture, or senior technology strategy roles. ·      Deep cross-domain expertise spanning applications, integration, data, AI, cloud, security, and platform strategy. ·      Experience supporting or leading architecture for large-scale transformation initiatives in complex enterprise environments. ·      Experience with architecture governance, standards development, target-state planning, and strategic technology decision-making. ·      Proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority. ·      Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. Preferred Education and Experience ·      Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry. ·      Experience in a federated technology organization with centralized architecture direction and distributed execution. ·      Experience with cloud modernization, API strategies, platform engineering, data ecosystems, and enterprise integration. ·      Familiarity with AI-enabled enterprise capabilities, automation, and emerging technology trends. ·      Advanced degree and/or relevant certifications such as TOGAF, SAFe, AWS, Azure, GCP, or equivalent. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities ·      Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture principles, methods, and governance practices. ·      Broad understanding of enterprise technology domains and cross-domain dependencies. ·      Ability to develop target-state architecture and pragmatic transition approaches. ·      Strong business acumen and ability to connect architecture decisions to business outcomes. ·      Ability to assess tradeoffs among speed, cost, quality, risk, and strategic fit. ·      Strong facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. ·      Ability to communicate effectively with executive, business, and technical audiences. ·      Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. ·      Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and lead through influence. Job Title: Head of Product Strategy & Platform Innovation
Job Description: The Head of Product Strategy & Platform Innovation is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic evolution, differentiation, and commercial success of our open‑architecture wealth management product platform. This individual wakes up every day thinking about what’s next —how product, partners, packaging, and go‑to‑market strategy come together to create a compelling, modern, and advisor‑centric platform across fee‑based advisory, annuities, and alternatives. We do not manufacture products. Our competitive advantage comes from curation, partnership, design, positioning, and delivery . This role exists to ensure our platform is not merely comprehensive—but distinctive, relevant, and growth‑oriented . The role works horizontally across the organization —marketing, sales, business development, training, product management—and externally with asset managers, insurance carriers, TAMPs, and portfolio managers . Success requires influence without direct ownership, entrepreneurial energy, and a strong commercial mindset. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Innovation Own the forward‑looking product strategy across advisory, annuities, and alternatives within an open‑architecture ecosystem. Identify gaps, white spaces, and emerging opportunities driven by advisor needs, client behavior, regulation, and competitive dynamics. Design differentiated product constructs, solutions, and portfolios by creatively leveraging third‑party partners rather than manufacturing products. Translate industry trends (e.g., retirement income, tax efficiency, private markets, managed solutions, model portfolios) into actionable platform initiatives. Platform Differentiation & Go‑to‑Market Develop clear go‑to‑market strategies for platform capabilities, including positioning, messaging, and advisor value propositions. Partner closely with Marketing to ensure product stories are simple, compelling, and commercially effective . Work with Sales and Business Development to align product strategy with advisor adoption, growth objectives, and field readiness . Drive clarity around why advisors should use specific solutions—not just what is available. Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Management Serve as a senior point of engagement with asset managers, insurance carriers, TAMPs, and product sponsors . Evaluate, onboard, and rationalize partners with a focus on quality, differentiation, economics, and strategic fit . Co‑create solutions with partners where appropriate, including custom portfolios, white‑labeled offerings, or exclusive access strategies . Maintain a strong commercial lens on platform economics, scalability, and advisor impact. Cross‑Functional Leadership & Influence Act as a strategic connector across Product Management, Sales, Marketing, Training, and Business Development. Provide strategic direction while leveraging existing execution teams for implementation. Influence priorities and outcomes without direct people ownership , using clarity, credibility, and collaboration. Partner with Training and Sales Enablement to ensure advisors understand not just products—but how to use them in holistic planning conversations . What Success Looks Like Advisors view the platform as thoughtful, differentiated, and easy to position with clients . Product initiatives are clearly linked to advisor adoption, client outcomes, and revenue growth . Partners see the firm as a strategic collaborator , not just a distributor. The platform evolves proactively— not reactively —to market and advisor needs. Qualifications & Experience 10+ years of experience in wealth management, asset management, insurance, or fintech, with exposure to RIA and broker‑dealer environments . Deep knowledge of fee‑based advisory, annuities, alternatives, and managed solutions . Demonstrated ability to build or evolve open‑architecture platforms without manufacturing products. Strong commercial and go‑to‑market orientation —understands how strategy translates into advisor behavior. Proven success working cross‑functionally and influencing outcomes without direct authority. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to balance vision with practical execution . Comfortable operating with ambiguity and turning ideas into scalable initiatives. Why This Role Matters This role ensures our product platform moves from “robust but pedestrian” to strategically curated, commercially sharp, and advisor‑obsessed —without disrupting what already works operationally. It complements strong execution with vision, innovation, and market leadership . Job Description: Senior MS SQL Database Engineer Position Summary We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior MS SQL Database Engineer to lead the design, architecture, governance, and operational support of enterprise database platforms. This role combines strategic architecture responsibilities with deep hands-on database administration expertise, ensuring highly available, performant, secure, and resilient SQL Server environments across on-premises and cloud platforms. The ideal candidate will serve as the technical leader for SQL Server technologies, drive database modernization initiatives, establish architecture standards, and provide operational support for mission-critical applications. This individual will partner with application teams, infrastructure teams, cloud engineering, security, and business stakeholders to design scalable database solutions while maintaining operational excellence. Key Responsibilities Database Engineering & Strategy Define and maintain enterprise SQL Server architecture standards and best practices. Design scalable, secure, and highly available database solutions supporting critical business applications. Lead database modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, migration, and platform transformation. Develop architecture roadmaps for SQL Server, AWS SQL, AWS RDS SQL Server, and related technologies. Evaluate emerging database technologies and recommend strategic investments. Establish standards for High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), backup, recovery, monitoring, and automation. Review application database designs and provide guidance on data modeling, indexing strategies, scalability, and performance. Database Administration Perform installation, configuration, patching, upgrading, and maintenance of Microsoft SQL Server environments. Administer SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, Replication, Log Shipping, and Disaster Recovery solutions. Manage database security, auditing, encryption, and compliance requirements. Execute backup, recovery, refresh, migration, and upgrade activities. Support production, development, test, and disaster recovery environments. Monitor database health, capacity, availability, and performance. Performance & Reliability Engineering Diagnose and resolve complex database performance issues. Conduct SQL query tuning and optimization. Analyze execution plans, indexing strategies, resource utilization, and workload patterns. Develop proactive monitoring and automated remediation solutions. Perform capacity planning and growth forecasting. Cloud & Automation Architect and support SQL Server solutions within AWS and hybrid cloud environments. Lead migrations from on-premises SQL Server to AWS RDS, EC2, and cloud-native platforms. Develop Infrastructure-as-Code solutions utilizing Terraform and CI/CD pipelines. Create automation solutions using PowerShell, SQL scripts, and orchestration tools. Implement self-healing and operational automation capabilities. Leadership & Technical Governance Serve as the technical authority for SQL Server within the organization. Mentor and develop junior DBAs and Database Engineers. Establish governance processes, architecture reviews, and technical standards. Participate in incident response and major outage management. Collaborate with application development teams on database design and deployment strategies. Provide technical leadership during audits, compliance reviews, and business continuity exercises. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field. 10+ years of Microsoft SQL Server administration experience. 5+ years of enterprise database architecture experience. Expert knowledge of: SQL Server 2019, 2022 and 2025 Always On Availability Groups SQL Server Clustering Replication Backup and Recovery Performance Tuning Security and Compliance Deep understanding of SQL Server storage engine internals. Strong T-SQL development and query optimization skills. Experience with SSIS, SSRS, and SQL Server Management Studio. Extensive PowerShell scripting and automation experience. Strong knowledge of SDLC, DevOps, and Change Management processes. Experience supporting large-scale, business-critical database environments. Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AWS services including: RDS EC2 Aurora CloudWatch CloudTrail Experience with Terraform, GitHub, Bitbucket, Jenkins, or other CI/CD platforms. Knowledge of containerized database deployments and Kubernetes. Experience with database observability tools such as Foglight and  Zenoss. Success Indicators Maintains database availability exceeding established service-level objectives. Successfully delivers database modernization and migration initiatives. Reduces operational risk through automation and standardization. Improves database performance, resiliency, and security posture. Enables application teams through scalable and efficient database architectures. Job Description: Do you enjoy managing complex sales processes, collaborating across teams, and ensuring clients receive accurate and competitive benefit solutions? Guardian is seeking a Sales Analyst, Premier Markets to serve as a dedicated field resource supporting Sales Representatives and Client Management teams within our Group Benefits business. In this role, you will be responsible for managing RFPs, coordinating quote delivery, facilitating new business submissions, and partnering with internal stakeholders to help drive profitable growth. You will leverage strong analytical, organizational, and relationship-building skills to support sales success while delivering an exceptional customer experience. You Are A detail-oriented and process-driven professional who thrives in a fast-paced sales environment. You excel at managing multiple priorities, collaborating across teams, and ensuring deliverables are completed accurately and on time. You balance customer needs with business objectives and take a proactive approach to problem-solving and communication. As a professional, you: Demonstrate strong organizational and project management skills. Thrive in structured environments and follow established procedures while maintaining flexibility to meet changing business needs. Build strong partnerships with Sales Representatives, Underwriters, brokers, and internal stakeholders. Communicate proactively and effectively with both internal and external partners. Leverage analytical skills to support pricing, proposal, and sales strategies. Balance competitiveness, profitability, and risk when evaluating opportunities. Effectively negotiate and influence outcomes while maintaining strong business relationships. Utilize technology and systems efficiently to manage workflows and support business objectives. Maintain a customer-focused mindset while ensuring operational excellence and accuracy. You Will Manage RFP inventory, quote requests, and new business/add issue submissions in support of Premier Market sales activity. Review RFP documentation, identify missing requirements, and coordinate information gathering to support underwriting and proposal development. Partner with Rating, Quoting, Underwriting, Client Management, and Sales teams to ensure competitive proposals are delivered accurately and on time. Analyze RFP opportunities and recommend plan design, benefit, and pricing alternatives based on customer needs and market conditions. Collaborate with internal business partners including Dental, BenTech, Enrollment, Worksite, and other stakeholders to develop comprehensive proposal strategies. Participate in underwriting discussions and negotiations related to rates, plan designs, exceptions, and approvals. Communicate directly with brokers, producers, and their support teams regarding proposal details, product offerings, and quote competitiveness. Conduct follow-up activities to gather feedback, assess market competitiveness, and obtain post-mortem information on opportunities. Experience supporting RFP processes, proposal management, quoting, underwriting, or new business submissions. Knowledge of Group Benefits products and services. Understanding of underwriting principles and practices. Experience servicing brokers, producers, clients, or other external customers. Proven ability to work effectively in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Adobe Acrobat, and CRM systems. Ability to effectively collaborate across multiple functional areas. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree. Salesforce experience. Experience supporting field sales organizations. Knowledge of Group Benefits quoting, rating, and onboarding processes. Experience working with brokerage or producer distribution channels. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Reporting Relationships As our Sales Analyst, Premier Markets , you will support the Group Benefits Sales organization and partner closely with Sales Representatives, Client Management, Underwriting, Rating, Onboarding, and Operations teams. Job Description: Do you want to lead a critical function that directly impacts customer satisfaction, retention, and business growth? Guardian is seeking a Head of Implementation to lead the end-to-end implementation experience across our Select, Premier, Advisory, and Key market segments. In this role, you will be accountable for ensuring customers receive a seamless onboarding experience from notice of sale through successful setup, data exchange activation, and first premium payment. You will serve as the business process owner for implementation, driving operational excellence, service quality, customer outcomes, risk management, and continuous improvement while building and developing high-performing teams that deliver exceptional results. You Are A strategic and results-driven leader with a proven track record of leading implementation organizations across multiple market segments. You are a collaborative business partner who can align teams around business priorities, execute with discipline, and continue building the Implementation organization’s reputation as a trusted and valued partner across Group Benefits. As a leader, you: Develop and inspire high-performing teams. Earn trust and confidence through transparency, accountability, and strong execution. Serve as the accountable business owner for the end-to-end implementation process, ensuring process performance, operating standards, service quality, customer satisfaction, and business results across all market segments. Foster a culture of inclusion, engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement. Lead effectively through changing business priorities while maintaining consistent customer and operational performance. Balance operational excellence with disciplined execution and strong customer outcomes. Demonstrate courage in decision-making and accountability for outcomes. Model Guardian’s values and customer-centric culture. Build strong partnerships and influence across a complex matrixed organization. Design and oversee implementation service models that support the needs of each market segment, balancing operational efficiency and scalability with differentiated experiences for larger and more complex customers. Direct implementation operations to balance customer needs, service excellence, productivity, capacity utilization, and financial performance. Develop and manage service, quality, productivity, expense, risk, customer experience, and financial performance metrics that support achievement of business commitments. Drive operational excellence through performance management, standardization, quality oversight, root-cause resolution, and continuous process improvement. Leverage customer feedback, service outcomes, and operational performance data to identify and implement opportunities that improve customer satisfaction, retention, and operational effectiveness. Collaborate with Sales, Client Management, Product, Technology, and Operations leaders to ensure implementation processes effectively support customer needs, business growth, and operational readiness. Partner with Technology, Product, and Transformation teams to ensure operational requirements, business priorities, and customer needs are incorporated into future-state solutions. Provide operational leadership and implementation expertise to support successful deployment, adoption, and ongoing support of new capabilities, tools, and processes while maintaining service commitments. Champion change adoption by reinforcing business purpose, aligning internal and external messaging, and removing barriers through visible leadership support. Lead, coach, and develop managers and team leaders while building organizational capabilities, workforce strategies, and talent pipelines that support business growth and employee development. Strong operational and technical background with demonstrated analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Experience leading process improvement and operational excellence initiatives. Strong understanding of EDI, data exchange solutions, implementation processes, and customer onboarding practices. Exceptional communication and influence skills with the ability to partner effectively across matrixed organizations. Experience managing budgets, workforce planning, and organizational performance. Experience leading implementation functions supporting multiple customer segments and distribution models. Knowledge of group benefits administration, enrollment, eligibility, billing, and customer onboarding processes. Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or other continuous improvement methodology experience. If so, Guardian is seeking a motivated individual to join our team as an Actuary, Group Benefit Pricing & Transformation. The successful candidate will lead and transform actuarial pricing capabilities across Guardian’s Group Benefits portfolio, including dental, vision, absence and disability, life, and supplemental health offerings. This role requires deep actuarial pricing expertise, sound business judgment, an innovative mindset, and leadership skills to drive pricing sophistication and strengthen data-driven decision-making. Manage pricing analyses, including experience monitoring, actual-to-expected reviews, assumption assessments, and profitability driver identification. Translate complex actuarial, financial, and technical analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership. Lead and develop a team of actuarial professionals and students by setting priorities, managing performance, and building capabilities required for both pricing excellence and transformation delivery. Strong analytical and technical capabilities to synthesize complex information, identify key drivers, evaluate emerging trends, and develop actionable insights and recommendations. Strategic problem-solving skills, with experience applying predictive analytics, machine learning, or pricing modernization solutions to improve business decision-making preferred. Ability to influence senior leaders, technical teams, and business stakeholders by translating actuarial pricing and transformation topics into clear business recommendations. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables simultaneously. Demonstrated experience leading actuarial teams, including developing talent, setting priorities, and managing performance. At least 5 years of experience in the insurance industry and FSA designation from the Society of Actuaries. Reporting Relationship As Actuary, Group Benefit Pricing & Transformation, you will report to the Head of Group Benefits Pricing & Analytics. Job Description: Is the opportunity to join a culture where “We Do the Right Thing,” and “We Courageously Shape Our Future Together” important to you? If so, Guardian is seeking a motivated individual to join our team as Lead Specialist, General Audit. This role will support the Head of Corporate Shared Services, Internal Audit. Typically, this position functions as a working audit project manager, fully responsible for planning, executing, and reporting audits independently and, on occasion, within a team. This role is focused on performing high quality, value-add, assurance and advisory services that identify, evaluate, and report on highly complex business risks and controls in accordance with the Institute of Internal Auditors Standards and established methodologies. This role will identify meaningful observations about the design and operating effectiveness of controls and discuss with various levels of manag ement on improving the internal control environment. You will be frequently sought after as a key resource for complex assignments. This position is focused on the Corporate Functions (e.g., Strategic Initiatives, Corporate Development, Law, Compliance, Marketing, Communication, Talent & Culture, etc.) with the possibility of covering other business and functional areas of the Company. You are An individual who is highly efficient and effective to lead an audit from planning, execution, and reporting. Possesses an experienced knowledge level of business processes, risks, and controls. You have a strong knowledge of general business and the insurance industry. Ability to multi-task and exemplify strong organizational skills and project management skills in a deadline-driven environment. You will Lead and execute complex assurance projects in accordance with established methodologies and professional standards. Demonstrate influencing skills when communicating with business areas and other risk assurance providers aimed to continually improve relationships and enable management to proactively manage risk. Collaborate with other members of the audit team to leverage their skill sets, experience, and expertise; providing the same. Act as a mentor to new or less experienced auditors by providing guidance on Department processes and sharing knowledge of Company operations, product lines, etc. Monitor all outstanding recommendations and action plans for the assigned audits; prepare status commentary and perform follow-up testing as needed. Provide advisory services on projects, business functions, and processes, if requested. Provide governance, compliance, investigation, and enterprise risk assessment support, if requested. Assist the external auditors and the Controls Assurance team (Model Audit Rule Program) through coordinating and executing direct assistance testing for select assignments. Work with Internal Audit leadership to identify and continuously improve departmental practices. Monitor and demonstrate compliance with departmental policies and practices, as evidenced by strong quality assurance results, and strong performance within standards and related metrics. Stay abreast of current issues, standard industry practices, regulations, and obtain continuing education and training. Participate in special projects and perform other duties as requested. Interact with all levels of management to provide effective risk and control advice, maintaining active communication with clients to enhance risk and control awareness and manage expectations. You have 5+ years of broad-based experience in internal audit, external audit, or related functions. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to effectively assess a process, analyze data, and assess risks and controls. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage concurrent projects (multi-task) and meet deadlines with minimal supervision. Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to write clearly and concisely. Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and clearly articulate thoughts and ideas. Ability to collaborate with others, both inside and outside of the department, while working toward common goals and fostering understanding and agreement. Experience in the insurance or financial services industry is a plus. Working knowledge of information technology, cybersecurity, and ability to apply to operational audits is a plus. Understanding of enabling technologies, including robotics process automation (RPA), natural language processing (NLP), and/or artificial intelligence (AI) is a plus. Job Title: Head of Data Engineering, Corporate & Enterprise
Job Description: Position Overview: The Head of Data Engineering, Corp & Enterprise is a mid- leadership role accountable for the end-to-end data engineering lifecycle across Guardian's Corporate and business unit and Enterprise, from source data acquisition, ingestion, and transformation through the delivery of trusted, production-ready data products that power AI, machine learning, reporting, analytics, and business applications. This leader owns the strategy, architecture direction, engineering execution, and operational health of the data supply chain that downstream teams depend on every day. This is a player-coach role. The Head of Data Engineering leads a team of US FTEs and provides direction to an extended indirect engineering team in India, building a high-performing, globally distributed delivery model with clear standards, strong engineering discipline, and a culture of ownership. While the role is primarily a leadership position, the leader is expected to stay technically current and go hands-on when needed reviewing designs, unblocking complex engineering problems, and setting the bar for quality through example. A core mandate of this role is ownership and maturing Guardian's Master Data Management (MDM) practice. The leader will manage MDM operations and evolve the practice from foundational capability to enterprise-grade discipline - strengthening match and merge rules, survivorship, golden record quality, data stewardship workflows, and domain expansion. Deep, practical knowledge of Reltio is essential, including its data model, match engine, workflows, integrations, and APIs. Equally important, this leader carries a transformation mandate: to take data engineering to its next level using AI agents and agentic AI. This means reimagining how pipelines are built, tested, monitored , and healed : embedding AI-assisted development, autonomous data quality and observability agents, and agentic workflows across the engineering lifecycle to dramatically increase speed, reliability, and scale. The right candidate sees agentic AI not as a tool to adopt, but as a new operating model for data engineering and has the vision and pragmatism to lead the organization and the new operating model . Key Responsibilities: Own end-to-end data engineering for the Corporate business units and Enterprise - source data acquisition, ingestion, integration, transformation, curation, and publication of production-ready data products for AI, ML, reporting, analytics, and application consumption Define and execute the data engineering strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned to business unit priorities and Guardian's enterprise data and AI strategy Lead, coach, and develop a team of FTE data engineers; provide direction, standards, and delivery oversight to an indirect engineering team in India, operating a seamless follow-the-sun global delivery model Operate as a player-coach , remain hands-on as needed with solution design, code and pipeline reviews, complex troubleshooting, and critical delivery moments Own and manage the MDM platform and operations on Reltio, including data modeling, match/merge rules, survivorship, workflows, integrations, and API-based consumption Mature the MDM practice into an enterprise-grade discipline , improve golden record quality, expand mastered domains, strengthen data stewardship and governance workflows, and measure and communicate MDM business value Lead the transformation of data engineering using agentic AI , deploy AI agents for pipeline development, code generation, testing, documentation, data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, and self-healing operations Champion AI-assisted engineering practices across the team, redefining team workflows, productivity expectations, and engineering roles for an agentic future Deliver governed, discoverable, reusable data products with clear contracts, SLAs, lineage, and ownership , treating data as a product with defined consumers and measurable quality Partner closely with AI/ML, analytics, reporting, and application teams to ensure data products are AI- ready , supporting feature pipelines, model training data, and retrieval-ready datasets for GenAI use cases Establish and enforce engineering standards, reusable patterns, CI/CD, DataOps automation, and observability across all pipelines and platforms Build reusable tools, libraries, frameworks, and shared services that productize and scale engineering best practices, and actively drive their adoption across Data Engineering to accelerate delivery, raise quality, and eliminate duplicated effort Drive data quality, reliability, and operational excellence - define SLAs/SLOs, reduce incidents, and ensure resilient, cost-optimized cloud data platform operations Embed data governance, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance requirements into all data engineering and MDM solutions in partnership with Data Governance, Cybersecurity, and Risk Manage vendor relationships and platform economics, including Reltio and cloud data platform spend, with a focus on value and FinOps discipline Influence and align senior business and technology stakeholders; translate business needs into engineering priorities and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes with clarity Recruit, retain , and grow top engineering talent; build succession depth and elevate the technical maturity of both onshore and offshore teams Available for production incidents with major impact to business operations You Have: 12+ years of progressive data engineering experience, including 5+ years leading data engineering teams and delivery at scale in a large enterprise and have experience in Finance, actuaries, HR related data and workflows. Proven experience leading globally distributed teams, including direct FTE leadership and indirect/offshore teams in India, within a matrixed organization Demonstrated ability to operate as a player-coach - setting strategy and leading people while staying hands-on with architecture, design, and engineering when needed Deep expertise across the end-to-end data engineering lifecycle: data acquisition, batch and streaming ingestion, ELT/ETL, data modeling, curation, and productionization of data products Strong hands-on knowledge of the modern data stack including cloud data platforms (e.g., Fivetran , Databricks), orchestration (e.g., Databricks, Airflow), transformation frameworks (e.g., Spark , dbt ), streaming (e.g., Kafka), and CI/CD-driven DataOps A strong software engineering mindset and execution skills, with a proven track record of designing and building reusable tools, libraries, and frameworks, applying sound software design principles, testing, and documentation, and driving their adoption across engineering teams to multiply productivity and impact Strong Master Data Management expertise with deep, practical knowledge of Reltio - data modeling, match/merge and survivorship configuration, workflows, integrations, and APIs and a track record of maturing an MDM practice Forward-leaning experience with AI-assisted and agentic engineering using LLMs and AI agents for code generation, testing, data quality, observability, and autonomous operations and a compelling vision for agent-driven data engineering Experience delivering AI/ML-ready data and GenAI/retrieval-ready data foundations Strong grounding in data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, and privacy/security practices, ideally in a regulated industry such as insurance or financial services A data-as-a-product mindset with experience defining data contracts, SLAs, and consumer-driven design Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and convey complex technical concepts to business audiences Experience with Agile / product-based delivery models and managing delivery across onshore/offshore teams A bias for action, high standards , and the ability to balance transformation ambition with operational stability Location: Three days a week at a Guardian location on Holmdel, NJ, New York, NY, or Bethlehem, PA Salary Range: $152,290.00 - Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture and platform teams to reuse enterprise capabilities where appropriate . Job Description: Is the opportunity to join a culture where “We Do the Right Thing,” and “We Courageously Shape Our Future Together” important to you? If so, Guardian is seeking a motivated individual to join our team as an Executive Recruiter. The Executive Recruiter serves as a strategic talent advisor responsible for identifying, attracting, assessing, and engaging executive talent across the enterprise. This individual will partner closely with senior business leaders, HR Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition leadership to drive executive hiring outcomes while helping build a world-class internal Executive Search function. This role extends beyond search execution. The Executive Recruiter will develop deep expertise in supported business lines, cultivate executive talent pipelines, provide market intelligence, and build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the organization. The successful candidate will be able to manage multiple executive searches simultaneously, navigate complex stakeholder environments, and deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring leaders alike. As the Executive Search function evolves, this role will help establish Talent Acquisition as a strategic business partner by contributing to workforce planning, succession discussions, leadership pipeline development, and talent market insights. You have The ability to combine the relationship building skills of a trusted consultant, the discipline of a project manager, the curiosity of a researcher, and the urgency of a recruiter. Most importantly, you believe executive search is not simply about filling positions. It is about helping organizations make better leadership decisions and building talent pipelines that create long-term business success. Required Qualifications: Professional Experience 8+ years of recruiting experience within a retained search firm, corporate search function, or a combination of both. Demonstrated experience managing executive and senior leadership searches from intake through offer acceptance. Proven success in sourcing, engaging, and recruiting passive executive-level talent. Experience managing multiple concurrent searches while maintaining quality, responsiveness, and stakeholder confidence. Experience partnering directly with senior business leaders, HR Business Partners, and hiring executives throughout the search process. Executive Search & Recruitment Expertise Strong executive search methodology, including talent mapping, market research, candidate assessment, and executive outreach. Ability to develop and execute search strategies for complex leadership roles across multiple business functions. Experience building and maintaining executive talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs. Ability to assess leadership talent against technical requirements, leadership competencies, organizational culture, and business objectives. Stakeholder Management Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of an organization. Strong consultative skills with the ability to advise leaders on talent availability, market conditions, and hiring strategies. Experience facilitating intake meetings and translating business needs into actionable search plans. Ability to provide clear updates, recommendations, and guidance throughout the search process. Project & Pipeline Management Exceptional organizational skills and ability to manage multiple complex searches simultaneously. Strong project management capabilities with attention to detail and a sense of urgency. Experience utilizing ATS, CRM, and recruiting technologies to manage candidate pipelines and search activity. Ability to maintain accurate search documentation, reporting, and candidate engagement records. Communication & Relationship Building Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish credibility quickly with executives and candidates. Commitment to delivering an exceptional candidate experience through transparency, responsiveness, and professionalism. Preferred Qualifications: Executive Search & Talent Advisory Experience Experience supporting organizational talent strategies beyond recruiting, including succession planning, leadership assessment, workforce planning, or talent management initiatives. Experience serving as a strategic talent advisor to executive leadership teams. Business & Organizational Consulting Ability to quickly understand business models, organizational structures, and operating environments. Experience consulting with leaders on organizational design, leadership effectiveness, or capability requirements. Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into talent acquisition and talent development recommendations. Talent Intelligence & Market Insights Advanced experience conducting executive talent mapping, competitive intelligence, and labor market research. Experience presenting market insights and talent landscape analyses to executive audiences. Familiarity with executive compensation trends and leadership benchmarking practices. Technology & Analytics Experience utilizing LinkedIn Recruiter, executive search databases, talent intelligence platforms, and CRM technologies. Experience working within Workday or other enterprise ATS environments. Ability to leverage recruiting metrics, market data, and reporting tools to influence hiring decisions and improve outcomes. Leadership & Influence Experience mentoring recruiters, researchers, coordinators, or junior talent acquisition professionals. Proven ability to influence without direct authority in highly matrixed organizations. Demonstrated success leading search initiatives with senior executives and C-suite stakeholders. Location Hybrid role - 3 days in office in the Hudson Yards, NYC or Stamford, CT office; 2 days WFH. In-person collaboration is essential to building trusted relationships and driving strategic alignment across the organization.
